roots.origin: 拉丁语 unus（一，单独一个）；unio 指「一整个、独头的那颗」，罗马农人拿它称独头蒜，经古法语 oignon 进英语；uncia 是「十二分之一，一个小单位」，派出 ounce
roots.core_concept: one thing standing whole and alone / 单独一个，囫囵一整个
roots.core_image: 一根手指立在桌上，旁边空着，就这一个，再没有第二个

roots.origin: 拉丁语 laxare（松开、放开），来自 laxus（松的、不紧的）；经古法语 laissier（撂下不管）与 relaier（放开新犬接替）一支进英语，relais 本指撂下没带走的那部分
roots.core_concept: to let the tight go slack / 把绷紧的一放，那股劲就退了
roots.core_image: 手里攥的绳子一寸寸往外送，绷起的那股劲慢慢没了

roots.origin: 拉丁语 salvus（未受伤的、完好的），与 salus（属格 salutis：安好、健康）同支；salutare 是问一声安好，晚期拉丁语 salvare（使完好）经古法语 sauver 进英语
roots.core_concept: whole and unhurt, nothing lost / 囫囵完好，一点没伤没缺
roots.core_image: 大风过去，屋顶瓦一块没掉，人从门里走出来，身上干干净净

roots.origin: 拉丁语 insula（岛）；古法语 isle 进英语成 isle，意大利语 isolato（成了岛的）派出 isolate，paene（几乎）加 insula 指几乎成岛的那块地
roots.core_concept: land cut off by water all round / 四面是水，跟别处断开的一块地
roots.core_image: 一块地四周全是水，船撑走了，剩下的人再没有路通到对岸

roots.origin: 拉丁语 poena（罚、赔命的那笔账），借自希腊语 poinē（血债、赎金）；poenalis 派出 penalty，punire（施罚）经古法语 punir 进英语
roots.core_concept: the price exacted for a wrong / 做错事被讨回去的那笔账
roots.core_image: 打碎了别人的东西，被人按住不许走，非得赔上一笔才放行

roots.origin: 希腊语 idein（看见），名词 idea 本指看见时现出的那个形相；柏拉图拿它指事物背后那个完好的样子，故 idealis 是合于那个样子的
roots.core_concept: the form a thing shows when seen / 一样东西被看见时现出的那个形
roots.core_image: 眼睛一扫，那个形状先落进心里，东西搬走了，形状还在

roots.origin: 拉丁语 primus（第一的，序列最前的那个），比较级 prior（在前的、较早的）同出 pri- 一支；princeps（首位者）由 primus 与「占住位次」一支合成，故 prince/principal/principle 同族
roots.core_concept: the one standing at the front of the line / 站在序列最前的那一个
roots.core_image: 一队人排开，最前头那个先动，后面的都照他的位置往下排

roots.origin: 拉丁语 imago（宾格 imaginem：摹本、相像之物、心里浮出的样子），动词 imaginari 指在心里造出一个样子
roots.core_concept: a likeness that stands in for the thing itself / 一个替本物出面的摹样
roots.core_image: 水面映出岸边的树，一摇就散，可刚才那一下和真树分毫不差
roots.english_definition: likeness, picture, to picture in the mind

roots.origin: 拉丁语 reri（盘算、认定），过去分词 ratus 派出名词 ratio（逐笔算清后得出的账、比数、道理）；古法语 raison 由 rationem 来，故 reason 同族。词根 id 取 reri-ratio，以避与英文单词 ratio 同名
roots.core_concept: the account that comes out even after reckoning / 逐笔算平之后得出的那个数
roots.core_image: 账房把两列数字对齐，一笔笔划掉，剩下的差额就是要报的那一个

roots.origin: 拉丁语 foris/foras（在门外、到门外去），与 fores（门扇）同支；forum 本指门外那片敞地，故成集会市集之所；中世纪拉丁语 forestis silva 指圈地之外的林子，故 forest（另有一说来自日耳曼语 furhitha 松林，未有定论）
roots.core_concept: outside the door, beyond what is enclosed / 门外，围起来的那圈之外
roots.core_image: 一道门槛，跨出去就是没人管的那一片，屋里的规矩到此为止

roots.origin: 拉丁语 pax（宾格 pacem：相争双方摆平后的状态），动词 pacare 意为安抚、摆平；古法语 paier 由 pacare 来，本义是把债主安抚下来，故英语 pay 与 peace 同族
roots.core_concept: a dispute put to rest so neither side presses on / 相争摆平，两边都不再往下追
roots.core_image: 两人各退一步，钱货一交，攥着的手松开，谁也不再提这事

roots.origin: 拉丁语 plus（更多，multus 的比较级），复数 plures 派出 pluralis（多于一的）；surplus 由古法语 sur-（越过）＋plus 合成。词根 id 加 -more 以避与英文单词 plus 同名；表「填满」的 ple- 一支在拉丁语中已是另一个词，不可并入
roots.core_concept: the amount past what was counted / 越过原有数目的那一部分
roots.core_image: 秤盘上添到刻度还不停，指针又往前挪了一格

roots.origin: 拉丁语 rota（轮子）的指小形 rotula（小轮、小圆片），中世纪拉丁语 rotulus 指卷成筒的羊皮纸卷；rotare（使转）、rotundus（圆的）同出 rota——一片圆的东西滚起来，或一张纸绕着自己卷成筒，是同一个动作
roots.core_concept: a little wheel, and anything wound round on itself / 一只小轮子，以及绕着自己卷起来的东西
roots.core_image: 一张长纸从一头绕起来，卷成一个能在桌上滚的筒
roots.english_definition: to roll, to wind into a round

roots.origin: 拉丁语 radius（细杆、车轮的辐条、光线），radiare 是「射出光来」；辐条从轮心一根根直伸到轮缘，光从一点直射开去，是同一个形。词根 id 加 -ray 后缀，因 radius 本身是本批要收的单词，作 id 会顶掉词根节点（照 campus-field、edere-publish 先例）
roots.core_concept: a spoke running straight out from the centre / 从中心直伸出去的一根辐条
roots.core_image: 车轮的辐条从轴心直直伸到边上，一根接一根排开
roots.english_definition: a ray, a spoke; to shine out from a centre

roots.origin: 希腊语 ekhein（拿住、持有，也表「按住不让动」），其不定式词干 skhe- 派出 skholē（从活计里扣下来的闲时，后指讲学之所）、skhēma（事物被持成的样子）、epokhē（被按停的那一刻）；经拉丁语 schola、schema 入英语
roots.core_concept: to hold, and to hold a thing still / 持住，并把一样东西按停
roots.core_image: 手按在一样正动的东西上，它停住了，就那样被拿在手里
roots.english_definition: to hold, to hold back, to stop

roots.origin: 拉丁语 mille（一千），复数 milia；mille passuum（一千双步）就是古罗马的一里，英语 mile 由此。milli- 作前缀反过来表「千分之一」，因为一千份里只取一份
roots.core_concept: a thousand of a thing / 一千份
roots.core_image: 一千步走完，路边立一块石头；石头之间那一段路，长短都一样

roots.origin: 拉丁语 honos（后作 honor：众人给的看重、体面），honestus 是「配得上这份看重的」，honorare 是「把这份看重给出去」。词根 id 用古体主格 honos，因 honor 本身是本批要收的单词，作 id 会顶掉词根节点（照 campus-field 先例）
roots.core_concept: the regard other people give you / 众人给你的那份看重
roots.core_image: 他一进门，屋里坐着的人都站了起来

roots.origin: 希腊语 poiein（做、造出来）：poiētēs 是「造的人」，poiēma 是「造出来的那件东西」；经拉丁语 poeta / poema 入英语——诗人在希腊人眼里首先是个手艺人，只是他的料是词
roots.core_concept: to make, to fashion a thing out of material / 拿料做出一件东西来
roots.core_image: 他把材料一件件挑好，拼成一样原先没有的东西

roots.origin: 拉丁语 novus（新的、初次出现的）；指小形 novellus 指新出的小东西，经古法语与意大利语 novella（新故事）入英语；renovare 即 re-＋novus（再变新）
roots.core_concept: just come into being, not seen before / 刚出现、此前没见过的
roots.core_image: 树枝顶端那截嫩芽颜色比别处浅，昨天这里还什么都没有

roots.origin: 拉丁语 calx（属格 calcis：石灰石、石灰）；指小形 calculus 指小石子，罗马人在板上摆石子记数，算术一义由此而来；古英语 cealc 是早期从拉丁语借入的同一词
roots.core_concept: a small white stone from burnt lime / 一粒烧石灰得来的白色小石
roots.core_image: 手心里一把白色小石粒，捏碎搓成粉，指缝间簌簌往下落

roots.origin: 拉丁语 fabrica（工坊、手艺活）← faber（匠人）；通俗拉丁语缩作 *faurga，经古法语 forge 入英语，故 forge 与 fabric 同出一词
roots.core_concept: a workshop where parts are worked into a whole / 把零件做成整件的那间工坊
roots.core_image: 棚子底下摆着砧和料，匠人一件件敲打拼接，出来的是原先没有的东西

roots.origin: 拉丁语 lacere（诱引、勾住），只存于复合词：delicere（引开、逗引）派出 deliciae（乐事）与 delectare（使愉悦）；与 placere（使中意）本是两个不相干的拉丁词，勿混
roots.core_concept: to draw someone in by pleasing them / 用好处把人勾过来
roots.core_image: 厨房飘出一股味道，本来要走的人停下脚，往那边看

roots.origin: 拉丁语 prehendere（伸手抓住），过去分词 prehensus；通俗拉丁语缩作 prendere，入古法语成 prendre（拿、抓），故英语这一支多拼作 pris；praeda（猎获物）是 prae-（在前）加同一个「抓」，即抓到手的那一份
roots.core_concept: reaching out and closing the hand on something / 伸手把东西攥进手里
roots.core_image: 手指合上，攥住的那样东西再挣也挣不脱
roots.english_definition: to seize, grasp, take hold of

roots.origin: 拉丁语 centum（一百），centuria 是百人编成的一队；法语 cent 入英语后既作钱的百分位，也作构词成分的「百」
roots.core_concept: a full count of one hundred / 数满一百的那一整份
roots.core_image: 一百个格子排满一整版，数到最后一格刚好齐

roots.origin: 拉丁语 intrare（走进去）← intra（在里面）；古法语作 entrer，故英语这一支拼作 enter/entr
roots.core_concept: crossing the threshold from outside to inside / 从外面跨过门槛到里面
roots.core_image: 一只脚迈过门槛，人从外头到了里头，门在身后合上

roots.origin: 拉丁语 metiri（量），过去分词 mensus，名词 mensura（量出来的尺寸）；与希腊语 metron 同出印欧语「量」的词根，本项目按拉丁一支另立，照 regula 与 rect 的先例
roots.core_concept: laying a standard against a thing to see how much / 拿尺贴上去，看它有多少
roots.core_image: 卷尺贴着一段东西拉开，停在某一格上，那一格就是它的量
roots.english_definition: to measure, mark off a quantity

roots.origin: 拉丁语 pes（属格 pedis：脚），形容词 pedalis（脚上的）、pedester（步行的）；expedire 本义把脚从绊索里解出来，故「脚」是这一支的本象
roots.core_concept: the foot a body moves on / 人靠它往前走的那只脚
roots.core_image: 一只脚踩下去，重心压过去，身子跟着往前挪一步

roots.origin: 拉丁语 nomen（属格 nominis：名字、名称），动词 nominare（叫出名字、指名）由此出；希腊语 onoma（名）同出一个更古的词干，故 anonymous 一支也归此族
roots.core_concept: the word by which a thing is called / 用来叫出某物的那个词
roots.core_image: 点名册上念出一串字，被念到的人应一声站起来

roots.origin: 拉丁语 decem（十），序数 decimus（第十）、duodecim（十二，duo＋decem）皆由此出；希腊语 deka（十）同出一个更古的词干，decade 经 dekas（一批十个）入英语。与 decere（相称，派出 decent）、decipere（诱骗，派出 deceive）不同根，勿混
roots.core_concept: a full count of ten / 数满十这一整批
roots.core_image: 十根手指全数过一遍，正好一把，再数就得从头起

roots.origin: 拉丁语 linum（亚麻），linea（亚麻搓成的细绳、拉直的绳）由此出——木匠绷紧一根亚麻绳往板上一弹，留下笔直一痕，故 linea 兼指线条与行列；古英语 lin（亚麻）多认为是早期借自拉丁语 linum。linum 自身更早词源不明，与希腊语 linon 一同多被判为地中海一带的外来词
roots.core_concept: a flax cord pulled taut / 一根亚麻绳绷紧后留下的那道直痕
roots.core_image: 两手把细绳绷紧，往木板上一弹，板面上留下笔直的一道痕

roots.origin: 拉丁语 gaudium（喜悦），动词 gaudere（心里高兴）；复数 gaudia 经古法语 joie 入英语作 joy。与 jocus（玩笑，派出 joke、jewel）是两个不同的拉丁词，古法语里 joie 与 joiel 拼写相近而来源两分，勿混
roots.core_concept: gladness welling up inside / 心里那股高兴涌上来
roots.core_image: 消息一听完，嘴角先控制不住，眼睛跟着亮起来

roots.origin: 拉丁语 navis（船），navalis（船的）与 navigare（navis＋agere：驱船而行）由此出；古法语 navie（一国的船队）入英语作 navy
roots.core_concept: a ship, and the water it crosses / 一条船，以及它要渡过的那片水
roots.core_image: 木壳吃水一半，桅上挂着旗，一队人立在甲板上，前头只有一片开阔的水

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unio（独头的一整个）→ 一层层裹成的那一颗
words.origin: 古法语 oignon ← 拉丁语 unio（属格 unionis：一整个、独头的那颗），罗马农人拿它称独头蒜
words.native_definition: a round vegetable with many layers and a strong smell
words.core_concept: a bulb grown as one layered ball – 一层层裹成一个球的那种根菜
words.core_image: 一层裹一层的球，刀切下去眼睛就开始发酸流泪
examples: She chopped an onion for the soup.
Fry the onions until soft.
semantic_expansions: 洋葱：一层层裹成一整颗、辣眼睛的那种菜
葱头：同一样东西，说的是它圆鼓鼓的那颗

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ uncia（十二分之一，一个小单位）→ 秤上最小的那一格
words.origin: 古法语 unce ← 拉丁语 uncia（十二分之一，一个单位），罗马的一磅分十二份，inch 亦出此词
words.native_definition: a unit of weight equal to about 28 grams; a very small amount
words.core_concept: the smallest single notch on the scale – 秤上最小的那一个刻度
words.core_image: 秤盘上放一枚小铜片，指针只挪了一格，轻得几乎压不住手
examples: Add two ounces of butter.
He showed not an ounce of fear.
semantic_expansions: 盎司：约二十八克的那个重量单位
一点点：少到只够一格，多用于说连这么点都没有

words.root_logic: unus（一）+ animus（心气）→ 众人一条心
words.origin: 拉丁语 unanimus（同心的）← unus（一）+ animus（心、气）
words.native_definition: agreed on by everyone, with nobody against it
words.core_concept: all minds turned the same way – 所有人的心朝着同一个方向
words.core_image: 举手表决，一屋子人的手全举起来，没有一只按下去
examples: The committee vote was unanimous.
They were unanimous in praising her.
semantic_expansions: 全体一致的：屋里每个人都站同一边，没有反对的
一致同意的：这一致落在同意上，表决时全票通过

words.root_logic: uni-（unus 一）+ -fy（使成为）→ 使合成一个
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 unificare（使成一体）← unus（一）+ -ficare（使成为）
words.native_definition: to bring separate parts together so they work as one
words.core_concept: to make many run as one – 把好几份弄成一份来运作
words.core_image: 几家小铺子打通了门板，挂上同一块招牌，从外面看就是一家
examples: The king unified the warring tribes.
One rule unifies the two systems.
semantic_expansions: 统一：把分散的几方并到一处、归到同一套规矩下
使成一体：并过之后彼此不再分开，当一个整的来用

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unio（并成一个）→ 合起来之后的那个整体
words.origin: 古法语 union ← 晚期拉丁语 unio（属格 unionis：合为一体）← unus（一）
words.native_definition: the act of joining together, or a group formed by joining
words.core_concept: separate parts made into one body – 分开的几份并成一个身子
words.core_image: 两条河在山口汇到一处，往下游只剩一道水面
examples: The workers formed a union.
Their union lasted forty years.
semantic_expansions: 联合：并到一处这件事本身
工会：工人并成一处、替大家说话的那个组织
联盟：几方长期并在一处的那种安排

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unicus（只此一个）→ 独此一份，再无第二
words.origin: 法语 unique ← 拉丁语 unicus（唯一的、独一个的）← unus（一）
words.native_definition: being the only one of its kind
words.core_concept: the only one of its kind anywhere – 同类里只有这一个，别处没有
words.core_image: 一屋子瓶子长得一样，只有那只釉色歪了，别处再找不出第二只
examples: Every single fingerprint is unique.
The town has a unique charm.
semantic_expansions: 独一无二的：世上只此一件，找不出第二件
独特的：不必真只有一件，但那个特点别处没有

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unitas（一个整的）→ 算作一个来数的那一份
words.origin: 16 世纪造词，仿拉丁语 unitas（一个整体）而成，用来译欧几里得的「可数的一」← unus（一）
words.native_definition: a single thing or amount counted as one whole
words.core_concept: one whole taken as the thing you count – 拿来当一个整的来点数的那份
words.core_image: 货架上一排牛奶，一盒算一份，点数时就这么一盒一盒数
examples: The book has twelve short units.
Price is given per unit.
semantic_expansions: 单位：计量时定下的那一份，如一米一克
单元：整套东西里划出的一段，如课本的一章
部件：整机里能单独拆出来算一个的那块

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unire（使成一个）→ 并到一处成一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 unire（使合为一）的过去分词 unitus ← unus（一）
words.native_definition: to join together, or to act together as one
words.core_concept: to come into one from many – 从好几份走到一份
words.core_image: 几股细线捻到一处，成了一根，再拉不断
examples: The threat united the villagers.
They united to fight the plan.
semantic_expansions: 联合：几方并到一处，一同行动
团结：并在一处之后彼此不散，劲往一个方向使
合并：两方并成一方，原来的界线取消

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unitas（成为一个的状态）→ 许多份合成一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 unitas（属格 unitatis：一体、合一）← unus（一）
words.native_definition: the state of being joined together or acting as one
words.core_concept: many parts holding as one thing – 许多份撑成一样东西
words.core_image: 拔河的一队人同时后仰，绳子那头看过去像一个人在拉
examples: The team showed real unity.
He called for national unity.
semantic_expansions: 统一：分开的部分并到一处、不再各行其是的那个状态
团结：人心不散，做事的劲朝一个方向
整体：从外面看只见一样东西，看不出是拼起来的

words.root_logic: unus（一）+ versus（转成的）→ universus（合成一整个）→ 一个不落全算在内
words.origin: 古法语 universel ← 拉丁语 universalis ← universus（合成一整个的）← unus（一）+ versus（转成的）
words.native_definition: true of or applying to everyone and everywhere
words.core_concept: holding everywhere with nothing left out – 处处都算得上，一个不落
words.core_image: 同一张表格发到各国，格式一模一样，谁拿到都照着填
examples: Clean water is a universal need.
The rule is not universal.
semantic_expansions: 普遍的：到哪里都成立，不限某地某人
通用的：一样东西各处都能用，不必换
全体的：说的是所有人所有件，没有例外

words.root_logic: unus（一）+ versus（转成的）→ universum（合成一整个的那全部）→ 无边无际的那一整个
words.origin: 古法语 univers ← 拉丁语 universum（全部合成的那一个）← universus ← unus（一）+ versus（转成的）
words.native_definition: all of space and everything that exists in it
words.core_concept: everything there is taken as one whole – 所有存在的东西合起来算一个
words.core_image: 夜里躺在田里往上看，黑的那一片没有边，什么都在里头
examples: The whole universe keeps expanding.
She wondered how the universe began.
semantic_expansions: 宇宙：星辰与空间合起来的那个没有边的整体
万物：同一个整体，说的是里头装着的所有东西

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ universitas（合成一体的那群人）→ 师生结成的一个整体
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 universitas（结成一体的团体，本指师生行会）← universus ← unus（一）
words.native_definition: a place where students study for degrees after school
words.core_concept: teachers and students bound into one body – 教的人和学的人结成的一个团体
words.core_image: 一片连着的楼和草坪，年轻人夹着书从这栋走到那栋
examples: She teaches at a small university.
He left university after one year.
semantic_expansions: 大学：能授学位、中学之后去读的那种学校
高等学府：同一类地方，说的是它在学制里的层级

words.root_logic: laxare（松开）→ laissier（撂下不管）→ 把手里的地方撂给别人用一段
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 les ← 古法语 laissier（撂下、让出）← 拉丁语 laxare（松开）
words.native_definition: a contract letting someone use property for a fixed time
words.core_concept: to let go of what you hold, for a set time – 把手里的撂给别人，讲定多久
words.core_image: 房东把钥匙推过桌面，纸上写明用到哪一天，这期间他不再进那扇门
examples: They signed a two-year lease.
He leased the shop to her.
semantic_expansions: 租约：讲明让出多久、收多少的那份契
租期：同一份契里划出的那段时间

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ lax（laxare 松开）→ 把绷起来的那股劲送回去
words.origin: 拉丁语 relaxare（放松、松开）← re-（回）+ laxare（松开）
words.native_definition: to become less tense, or to make a rule less strict
words.core_concept: to let the pulled-tight go back – 让绷紧的退回原样
words.core_image: 攥了一晚的笔终于放下，肩膀往椅背上一沉
examples: Sit down and relax for a while.
The rules were relaxed last year.
semantic_expansions: 放松：身上或心里那股绷着的劲退掉
松弛：肌肉或皮不再绷紧，垮下来一点
放宽：把管得死的条文往松处挪

words.root_logic: re-（接着）+ lay（laxare 放开）→ 放开手里的，交给接手的那一个
words.origin: 古法语 relaier（放开新犬接替）← re-（再）+ laier ← 拉丁语 laxare（松开）
words.native_definition: a race or process in which each one passes on to the next
words.core_concept: the first lets go as the next takes hold – 前一个松手，后一个接住
words.core_image: 前一个人把棍子塞进后一个人手里，自己立刻慢下来喘气
examples: She ran the final relay leg.
He relayed the message to me.
semantic_expansions: 接力：几人一段段跑、手手相交的那种赛
转达：把话从一个人手里递到另一个人
中继：中间那一站，把信号接过来再送出去

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ lease（laxare 松开）→ 手一松，让它走
words.origin: 古法语 relessier ← 拉丁语 relaxare（松开）← laxare（松开）
words.native_definition: to set free, or to let something out to the public
words.core_concept: to open the hand and let it go – 手一开，任它出去
words.core_image: 铁门推开一条缝，人从里头走出来，锁挂在旁边开着
examples: They released the birds at dawn.
The band released a new album.
semantic_expansions: 释放：把关着的人或物放走
放开：手上不再攥着，也用于放开管制
发布：把攥在手里没公开的东西放出去给众人

words.root_logic: laxare（放开）→ relaisser（撂下不带走）→ 咽下之后撂在嘴里的那一点
words.origin: 古法语 reles（残留的那点味）← relaisser（撂下、留下）← 拉丁语 relaxare ← laxare（松开）
words.native_definition: great enjoyment of something, or a spicy sauce eaten with food
words.core_concept: what stays behind after the mouthful – 一口咽下去之后留在嘴里的那点
words.core_image: 咽下去之后嘴里还留着一股，人闭着眼又回想了一遍
examples: He ate with obvious relish.
She relished the quiet evening.
semantic_expansions: 滋味：吃过之后留在嘴里的那股味
享受：把那点留下的味细细尝，引申为乐在其中
佐料：拌在菜里专为出那股味的酱

words.root_logic: salvus（完好）→ 古法语 sauf → 没伤着、也碰不着的状态
words.origin: 古法语 sauf ← 拉丁语 salvus（未受伤的、完好的）
words.native_definition: not in danger and not hurt; a strong box for valuables
words.core_concept: whole, and out of harm's reach – 囫囵着，且伤不着
words.core_image: 孩子从街上跑进院里，母亲把门闩上，外头的车声就隔在门外
examples: The children are safe at home.
He locked the papers in a safe.
semantic_expansions: 安全的：处在伤害到不了的地方
平安的：走过一段险处而人没损，多说结果
保险箱：厚铁做的柜，让里头的东西也处在伤害之外

words.root_logic: salvus（完好）→ salvitas（完好的状态）→ 不会伤着的那个状态
words.origin: 古法语 sauveté ← 中世纪拉丁语 salvitas ← salvus（完好的）
words.native_definition: the state of being free from danger or harm
words.core_concept: the condition of nothing being able to hurt you – 伤害碰不到你的那个状态
words.core_image: 工人下井前先把绳扣在腰上，扣好才敢往下踩
examples: Check the safety of the ladder.
They worried about her safety.
semantic_expansions: 安全：不会受伤、不会出事的那个状态
平安：人事过后没损没伤，偏说结果
保险装置：机器上专防出事的那个部件

words.root_logic: salvus（完好）→ salus（安好）→ salutare（问一声安好）→ 抬手道一声安好
words.origin: 拉丁语 salutare（问候、致敬）← salus（属格 salutis：安好、健康），与 salvus（完好的）同支
words.native_definition: to greet someone with a formal gesture of respect
words.core_concept: to wish another's wholeness aloud – 当面道一声你安好
words.core_image: 士兵右手一抬贴到帽檐，脚跟并拢，眼睛直看着对面
examples: The soldiers saluted the flag.
He raised his glass in salute.
semantic_expansions: 敬礼：抬手贴帽檐那套规定动作
致敬：用动作或话把看重之意表出来
问候：见面时道一声安好

words.root_logic: salvus（完好）→ salvare（使完好）→ salvatio（救回这件事）→ 从毁里被拉回完好
words.origin: 古法语 salvacion ← 晚期拉丁语 salvatio（拯救）← salvare（使完好）← salvus（完好的）
words.native_definition: the act of being saved from harm, ruin, or sin
words.core_concept: being pulled back from ruin into wholeness – 从要毁的地方被拉回到完好
words.core_image: 船斜得快翻了，上头抛下一条绳，人抓住被一寸寸拉上去
examples: They prayed quietly for salvation.
That loan was our salvation.
semantic_expansions: 救赎：宗教里灵魂从罪里被救回
拯救：从要毁的境地把人或物拉回来
救星：把人拉回来的那个人或那件事

words.root_logic: salvus（完好）→ salvare（使完好）→ 使它保住不损
words.origin: 古法语 sauver ← 晚期拉丁语 salvare（使完好、使不失）← salvus（完好的）
words.native_definition: to keep someone or something from harm or loss
words.core_concept: to keep it whole instead of losing it – 让它保住，别损掉
words.core_image: 他一手把人从水里拽上岸，另一只手还攥着那袋没花掉的钱
examples: He saved the boy from drowning.
She saves half her wages.
semantic_expansions: 救：把人或物从要毁的地方拉出来
储存：把东西留住不动，日后还在
节省：本要花掉的没花，留了下来

words.root_logic: insula（岛）→ insulatus（做成岛的）→ 四周围断，什么也过不去
words.origin: 拉丁语 insulatus（做成岛的）← insula（岛）
words.native_definition: to cover something so heat, sound, or electricity cannot pass
words.core_concept: to ring it round so nothing crosses – 四周围死，什么都过不来
words.core_image: 电线外面裹一层胶皮，手按上去一点也不打手
examples: They insulated the roof last winter.
Rubber insulates the copper wire.
semantic_expansions: 隔绝：四周围住，让外头的东西过不来
绝缘：围的是电，让电流走不出去
保温：围的是热，让热跑不掉

words.root_logic: insula（岛）→ 古法语 isle → 水里那一小块地
words.origin: 古法语 isle ← 拉丁语 insula（岛）；英语拼写里那个 s 是后人照拉丁词形补回去的
words.native_definition: a small island, used mostly in names and poems
words.core_concept: a little patch of land ringed by water – 被水围住的一小块地
words.core_image: 一小块地浮在水面上，走一圈用不了几分钟
examples: They sailed to a rocky isle.
The isle lies off the coast.
semantic_expansions: 小岛：面积不大、四面是水的那块地
岛：同一样东西，多见于地名与诗里的旧称

words.root_logic: insula（岛）→ 意大利语 isolato（成了岛的）→ 把它弄成四面不连的一块
words.origin: 意大利语 isolato（成了岛的、孤立的）← 拉丁语 insula（岛），经法语 isolé 进英语
words.native_definition: to keep someone or something apart from others
words.core_concept: to make it an island, joined to nothing – 弄成一座岛，跟谁都不连
words.core_image: 病人被推进单独一间，门关上，外头的人只在玻璃后头看
examples: They isolated the sick birds.
Scientists isolated the new virus.
semantic_expansions: 隔离：把人或物单独关开，不让接触
孤立：让它跟周围断了往来，独自一个
分离出：从混在一起的东西里把那一样单挑出来

words.root_logic: paene（几乎）+ insula（岛）→ 差一点就成岛的那块地
words.origin: 拉丁语 paeninsula ← paene（几乎）+ insula（岛）
words.native_definition: a piece of land almost surrounded by water
words.core_concept: land that fell just short of being an island – 差一点就断成岛的那块地
words.core_image: 一条地从岸上伸进海里，三面是水，只剩根上一截连着
examples: They drove down the peninsula.
The peninsula juts into the sea.

words.root_logic: poena（罚、要赔的那笔账）→ 古法语 peine（受的那份罪）→ 身上或心里那一下难受
words.origin: 古法语 peine（刑罚、苦）← 拉丁语 poena（罚、赔命的那笔账）
words.native_definition: an unpleasant feeling in the body or mind
words.core_concept: what the body is made to pay – 身上被讨去的那一笔
words.core_image: 他弯下腰去，手按在膝盖上，牙关咬着不出声
examples: She felt a sharp pain in her side.
It pained him to say no.
semantic_expansions: 疼痛：身上某处传来的那股难受
痛苦：同一股难受落在心里
使痛苦：让人心里受这股难受

words.root_logic: pain（poena 罚出来的那点难受）+ -ful（满是）→ 满是那股难受
words.origin: pain（苦）＋ -ful（满是……的）合成，中古英语造词 ← 拉丁语 poena（罚）
words.native_definition: causing pain in the body or distress in the mind
words.core_concept: full of what hurts – 满是让人难受的那股
words.core_image: 伤口一挨到水就往回缩，整条胳膊跟着一抖，脸也皱起来
examples: The injection was quite painful.
It was a painful decision.
semantic_expansions: 疼的：身上一碰就难受
痛苦的：心里那份难受，如做不下的决定
令人难受的：让旁人看着也不好受

words.root_logic: poena（罚）→ poenalis（关于罚的）→ 判下来要付的那一笔
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 poenalitas ← 拉丁语 poenalis（关于罚的）← poena（罚）
words.native_definition: a punishment for breaking a rule or law
words.core_concept: the price set for breaking a rule – 犯了规就得付的那笔
words.core_image: 哨子一响，裁判指着球门前那个点，全场人都退到线外
examples: The penalty for late payment is steep.
He scored from the penalty.
semantic_expansions: 处罚：违规之后加在身上的那一下
罚款：那一下算成钱
罚球：球场上判给对方的那一脚或一投

words.root_logic: poena（罚）→ punire（施罚）→ 照那笔账讨回来
words.origin: 古法语 punir ← 拉丁语 punire（惩罚）← poena（罚）
words.native_definition: to make someone suffer for doing something wrong
words.core_concept: to collect the price for a wrong – 把做错事那笔账讨回来
words.core_image: 打碎玻璃的孩子被叫到墙角站着，一晚上不许出门
examples: The school punished him for cheating.
They were punished quite harshly.
semantic_expansions: 惩罚：因做错事而让人吃苦头
处罚：按规矩定下的那种惩罚
重创：打得很惨，多用于比赛或战事

words.root_logic: de-（郑重地）+ dic（dicare 宣告）→ 当众说明这一样归谁
words.origin: 拉丁语 dedicare（宣告归属、献出）的过去分词 dedicatus ← de-（郑重）+ dicare（宣示归于）
words.native_definition: to give your time or work to something, or to name a work in someone's honour
words.core_concept: to say aloud whose this is – 当众说出这归谁
words.core_image: 新桥落成，桥头牌子上刻着一个人的名字，从此这桥就算他的
examples: She dedicated her life to teaching.
The book is dedicated to his mother.
semantic_expansions: 奉献：把时间精力全交给某事
致献：正式宣告某物归于某人或某事
题献：在书上写明这本给谁

words.root_logic: in-（朝着）+ dic（dicare 指明说出）→ 指给你看在哪儿的那样东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 index（属格 indicis：指示者、食指）← indicare（指出）← in-（朝）+ dicare（宣示）
words.native_definition: an alphabetical list at the back of a book, or a number showing change
words.core_concept: the finger that points to where it is – 那根指着东西在哪儿的手指
words.core_image: 翻到书最后几页，词一条条排着，后面跟着页码
examples: Look it up in the index.
The price index rose again.
semantic_expansions: 索引：书后按字母排的条目，指到页码
指数：一个数，指出物价或水平的高低变动
目录：列出内容在哪一处的那张表

words.root_logic: in-（朝着）+ dicare（宣示）→ 朝那一处点明，让人看见
words.origin: 拉丁语 indicare（指出、宣示）的过去分词 indicatus ← in-（朝）+ dicare（宣示）
words.native_definition: to show, point out, or make something clear
words.core_concept: to point at it so others see – 朝那处一指，让人看见
words.core_image: 他没说话，抬手往门那边一指，屋里人都跟着看过去
examples: The sign indicates the way out.
Her face indicated real surprise.
semantic_expansions: 表明：把情况摆明，让人知道
指出：把某一点单挑出来说
示意：不说话，用动作让人看懂

words.root_logic: idein（看见）→ idea（看见时现出的那个形）→ 心里现出的那个形
words.origin: 拉丁语 idea ← 希腊语 idea（形相、样子）← idein（看见）
words.native_definition: a thought or plan that forms in the mind
words.core_concept: the shape that forms in the mind – 心里现出来的那个形
words.core_image: 洗澡时忽然停住，手上还举着毛巾，眼睛看着一处不动
examples: She had a better idea.
The idea came to him suddenly.
semantic_expansions: 想法：心里冒出来的那一个念头
主意：那个念头指向该怎么做
概念：把一类东西归成的那个形，如时间的概念

words.root_logic: idea（心里那个形）+ -al（合于……的）→ 合于心里那个形的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 idealis（只存于形相的）← 希腊语 idea（形相）← idein（看见）
words.native_definition: best possible, exactly what is wanted; a standard one aims at
words.core_concept: matching the shape held in mind – 跟心里那个形一模一样
words.core_image: 图纸上画的那间屋，尺寸角度处处对得上，盖出来的总差一点
examples: This is the ideal spot for camping.
She fell short of her ideal.
semantic_expansions: 理想的：正好合上心里所要的那个样子
完美的：一点不差，挑不出短处
理想：心里立着的那个样子，用来当准头

words.root_logic: idea（观念）+ -logy（一套条理）→ 一套成系统的观念
words.origin: 法语 idéologie ← 希腊语 idea（形相、观念）+ -logia（学说）
words.native_definition: a set of beliefs held by a group, especially in politics
words.core_concept: ideas built into one system – 观念搭成的一整套
words.core_image: 墙上刷着几行口号，屋里人说话都从那几行里挑词
examples: The party changed its ideology.
He rejected that whole ideology.
semantic_expansions: 意识形态：一群人共守的那套政治观念
思想体系：同一套观念，说的是它自成条理的结构

words.root_logic: passare（迈步、经过）→ pas（跨出的一段）→ 跨出的那一步，以及跨得多快
words.origin: 古法语 pas（步子）← 拉丁语 pandere（张开）的过去分词，本指两腿张开跨出的那一段
words.native_definition: the speed of walking or doing something; a single step
words.core_concept: how far one stride goes and how fast they come – 一步跨多远、跟得多密
words.core_image: 队伍走得又快又匀，后面的人得小跑才跟得上
examples: He walked at a steady pace.
She paced the room all night.
semantic_expansions: 步速：单位时间里跨出多少步，引申为做事快慢
一步：跨出去那一段距离
踱步：来回跨来跨去，多因心里不安

words.root_logic: passare（经过）→ passage（通行）→ passagier（过路的那个人）
words.origin: 古法语 passagier（过路的人）← passage（通行）← 晚期拉丁语 passare（经过）
words.native_definition: a person travelling in a vehicle but not driving it
words.core_concept: one carried through, not steering – 被载着过去、不掌方向的那个人
words.core_image: 有人握着票靠窗坐着，窗外的景一直往后退，手不碰方向盘
examples: The bus carried forty passengers.
Passengers must show their tickets.
semantic_expansions: 乘客：坐在车船飞机上被载着走的人
旅客：同一个人，说的是他在旅途上这层身份

words.root_logic: passare（通过）+ port（港口、城门）→ 准你过关口的那份凭据
words.origin: 法语 passeport ← passer（通过，← 晚期拉丁语 passare）+ port（港口、城门）
words.native_definition: an official document allowing you to travel to other countries
words.core_concept: leave to pass through the gate – 准许你从这道门过去
words.core_image: 关口前伸手递过一个小本，对方翻开比着脸看，盖个章又推回来
examples: She renewed her passport last month.
He lost his passport abroad.
semantic_expansions: 护照：出入国境用的那本官方证件
通行凭证：泛指凭它就能过去的东西，如通往成功的敲门砖

words.root_logic: posse（能够）→ potentia（能力）→ potentialis（有那个能而未显出来）
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 potentialis（有能力的）← potentia（能力）← potens（有力的）← posse（能够）
words.native_definition: a quality that exists but has not yet been developed or shown
words.core_concept: the power a thing has but has not shown – 有那个能，只是还没显出来
words.core_image: 一粒种子攥在手里，看不出什么，埋下去几年后是一棵树
examples: The boy has real potential.
They discussed several potential buyers.
semantic_expansions: 潜力：现在还没使出来、日后能使出来的那股能
可能的：还没成真但能成真的
潜在的：已经在那儿、只是没露头的

words.root_logic: posse（能够）→ 通俗拉丁语 potere（能）→ 能把事做成的那股劲
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 pouair ← 通俗拉丁语 potere（能够）← 拉丁语 posse（能够）/ potis（有力的）
words.native_definition: the ability to do something or control others; energy that runs machines
words.core_concept: what makes doing possible – 让事情做得成的那样东西
words.core_image: 闸一推上去，整条街的灯同时亮了
examples: She has the power to decide.
The storm cut off our power.
semantic_expansions: 力量：能把事做成的那股劲
权力：那股劲落在管人管事上
电力：那股劲落在机器上，推着它转

words.root_logic: power（posse 能成事的那股劲）+ -ful（满是）→ 满是那股能成事的劲
words.origin: power（力）＋ -ful（满是……的）合成 ← 通俗拉丁语 potere ← 拉丁语 posse（能够）
words.native_definition: having great strength, influence, or effect
words.core_concept: full of what gets things done – 满是能把事做成的那股
words.core_image: 机器压下来，钢板陷进去一寸，旁边的人往后退了半步
examples: The engine is very powerful.
He made a powerful speech.
semantic_expansions: 强大的：本身劲头很足
有力的：那股劲使出来看得见效果
有影响的：那股劲落在人身上，说话有人听

words.root_logic: firmare（使固定）→ firma（讲定的固定租额）→ 按固定租金签下的那片地
words.origin: 古法语 ferme（租约、按定额租下的地）← 中世纪拉丁语 firma（固定租额）← 拉丁语 firmare（使固定）
words.native_definition: an area of land used for growing crops or keeping animals
words.core_concept: land held at a fixed rent – 按讲定的固定租额领下的那片地
words.core_image: 一片圈起来的地，牲口棚挨着谷仓，边上插着界桩
examples: They bought a small farm.
He farms two hundred acres.
semantic_expansions: 农场：连着屋舍牲口、成一份产业的那片地
农田：那片地里种庄稼的部分
养殖场：同一份地专用来养禽畜鱼虾的

words.root_logic: firmare（使固定）→ firma（固定租额）→ firmarius（按定额租地耕作的那个人）
words.origin: 古法语 fermier ← 中世纪拉丁语 firmarius（按定额租地的人）← firma ← firmare（使固定）
words.native_definition: a person who owns or works on land growing crops or raising animals
words.core_concept: the one working land held at fixed rent – 按定额领下那片地来做活的人
words.core_image: 天没亮就出门，胶靴上一层泥，手背晒得比袖子里深一截
examples: The farmer sold his wheat cheaply.
Farmers here depend on rain.
semantic_expansions: 农民：以耕种养畜为生的人
农场主：同一行里拥有那片地的那个人

words.origin: 古法语 melodie ← 晚期拉丁语 melodia ← 希腊语 melōidia（歌唱）← melos（曲调）+ aoidē（歌）
words.native_definition: a series of musical notes that make a pleasing tune
words.core_concept: notes strung in an order the ear follows – 音一个接一个排成耳朵跟得上的次序
words.core_image: 那几个音一路上去又落回来，听过一遍就能哼出来
examples: The melody stayed in my head.
She hummed a simple melody.
semantic_expansions: 旋律：高低起伏连成的那条线，能哼出来
曲调：同一条线，说的是它整支的样子
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 tragedie ← 拉丁语 tragoedia ← 希腊语 tragōidia ← tragos（山羊）+ aoidē（歌），本指祭仪上披羊皮合唱的那种戏
words.native_definition: a serious play with a sad ending, or a very sad event
words.core_concept: a story walking straight into ruin – 一路直走进毁灭的那种戏
words.core_image: 台上人一步步走向那个结局，台下都看出来了，谁也拦不住
examples: The play is a Greek tragedy.
The fire was a real tragedy.
semantic_expansions: 悲剧：结局败落的那种正剧
惨事：现实里那样的事，死伤或大损
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: ag（agere 驱动、做）+ -ent（正在做的那个）→ 替人出面做事的那一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 agens（属格 agentis：正在做的、行事的）← agere（驱动、做）
words.native_definition: a person who acts for another, or a thing that produces an effect
words.core_concept: the one doing it on another's behalf – 替别人出手去做的那个
words.core_image: 谈判桌那头坐的不是本人，是拿着授权书替他签字的那个
examples: Her agent handled the contract.
Yeast is the agent of change.
semantic_expansions: 代理人：受人委托、以他的名义办事的人
经办人：具体动手把事办下来的那个
作用剂：起作用把变化做出来的那样东西

words.root_logic: gravis（重）→ gravare（压重）→ grever（压得人抬不起来）→ 心上压着那一块
words.origin: 古法语 grever（压迫、使难受）← 拉丁语 gravare（加重、压）← gravis（重的）
words.native_definition: to feel or show deep sorrow, especially over a death
words.core_concept: to carry a weight on the heart – 心上压着一块重的
words.core_image: 她坐在床沿上一动不动，肩膀往下垮，像身上压着什么
examples: She grieved for her lost son.
They grieved together for weeks.
semantic_expansions: 悲伤：心里那份沉，压得人提不起劲
哀悼：那份沉冲着死者，且做出来给人看见
使伤心：把那份沉加到别人心上

words.root_logic: ad-（朝、贴上）+ plic（plicare 折叠）→ 把它折贴到那一处上头
words.origin: 古法语 aplier ← 拉丁语 applicare（贴上、附着）← ad-（朝）+ plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: to put something onto a surface, to make a formal request, or to be relevant
words.core_concept: to fold it onto something so it sticks – 把它折上去，贴住那一处
words.core_image: 药膏挤在指尖，往肩上按着抹开，贴得严严实实
examples: Apply the cream twice a day.
She applied for the teaching job.
semantic_expansions: 涂敷：把药或膏贴到皮肤上
申请：把写好的材料递上去贴到那个位子上
适用：某条规矩贴得上这件事

words.root_logic: in-（朝着）+ vid（videre 看）→ invidia 盯着人家看，心里发酸
words.origin: 古法语 envie ← 拉丁语 invidia（嫉妒）← invidere（怀恶意地看）← in-（朝）+ videre（看）
words.native_definition: a feeling of wanting what someone else has
words.core_concept: to look at what another has and want it – 盯着别人有的那样，心里想要
words.core_image: 隔着窗帘看邻居那辆新车，眼睛跟着挪，心里发紧
examples: He felt envy at her success.
She envied his easy manner.
semantic_expansions: 羡慕：看着别人所有而心里想要
嫉妒：那份想要里掺了不甘，见不得他好
羡慕的对象：被人这样看着的那个人或物

words.root_logic: prem（primus 第一）+ -ier → 排在最前的那个 → 首要的；名词化即一国之首
words.origin: 法语 premier（第一的）← 拉丁语 primarius（首位的）← primus（第一）
words.native_definition: first in position or importance; the head of a government
words.core_concept: the one placed at the very front – 摆在最前面的那一个
words.core_image: 名单上排在最上一行的那个名字，开会先听他说话
examples: The premier league draws the best players.
The premier met the visiting delegation.
semantic_expansions: 首要的：位置或分量排在最前
总理/首相：一国政府里排在最前的那个人

words.root_logic: prim（primus 第一）+ -ary → 序列或分量上排在最前的 → 最初的、分量最重的
words.origin: 拉丁语 primarius（首位的、第一等的）← primus（第一）
words.native_definition: most important, or coming first in order or stage
words.core_concept: first in order, hence first in weight – 序次在最前，因此分量也最重
words.core_image: 一串灯从头亮到尾，头一盏没点上，后面的都不会亮
examples: Safety is our primary concern here.
She teaches at a primary school.
semantic_expansions: 主要的：分量上排最前，别的都次于它
最初的：时间或次序上排在最前
初级的：整个阶梯里最前的那一级

words.root_logic: prime（primus 第一）→ 同类里排第一等的 → 最好的；用在时段上即一生中最盛的那一段
words.origin: 拉丁语 primus（第一的），经古法语 prime 入英语
words.native_definition: of the best quality or the most important kind; the best period of something
words.core_concept: the first-rate one, picked out from the rest – 从同类里挑出来的头一等
words.core_image: 摊上挑出来单独摆的那块肉，纹理均匀，价也另算
examples: This is prime farmland with rich soil.
He was in his prime at thirty.
semantic_expansions: 最好的：同类里排第一等的
首要的：分量上排最前的
鼎盛期：一生中状态排最前的那一段

words.root_logic: primit（primus 第一、最早）+ -ive → 停在最早那一段的 → 原始的；器物停在最早形态即粗糙
words.origin: 拉丁语 primitivus（最早的、初生的）← primus（第一）
words.native_definition: belonging to an early stage of development, or simple and crude
words.core_concept: still at the earliest stage – 还停在最早那一段
words.core_image: 一把石头磨出的刃，绑在木棍上，能用，削两下就得重绑
examples: The cave held primitive tools and bones.
Their equipment was primitive but it worked.
semantic_expansions: 原始的/早期的：停在发展最早那一段
简陋的：形态还是最早那样，没经过后来的改良

words.root_logic: prin（primus 第一）+ -ce（占住位次那一支）→ 占着头一个位置的人 → 王子、亲王
words.origin: 古法语 prince ← 拉丁语 princeps（首位者）：由 primus（第一）与占住位次的一支合成
words.native_definition: a son of a monarch, or a male ruler of a small state
words.core_concept: the man holding the first place – 占着头一个位次的男子
words.core_image: 宴席上他坐在国王右手边头一个座位，别人都往下排
examples: The prince rode ahead of the column.
A young prince ruled the mountain valley.
semantic_expansions: 王子：国王之下排第一位的男性后嗣
亲王：同一份「占头位」用在封地君主上

words.root_logic: princ（primus 第一）+ -ess（女性）→ 占着头一个位置的女子 → 公主、王妃
words.origin: 古法语 princesse ← princeps（首位者）的女性形，本源 primus（第一）
words.native_definition: a daughter of a monarch, or the wife of a prince
words.core_concept: the woman holding the first place – 占着头一个位次的女子
words.core_image: 她一进门，满屋的人先转过来，位子早给她空在最前
examples: The princess opened the new hospital wing.
He married the princess of a small kingdom.
semantic_expansions: 公主：君主之下排第一位的女性后嗣
王妃：同一份「占头位」用在配偶身上

words.root_logic: princip（princeps 首位）+ -al → 排在头一位的 → 主要的；学校里排头位的人即校长；一笔款里排头位的那部分即本金
words.origin: 拉丁语 principalis（首要的）← princeps（首位者）← primus（第一）
words.native_definition: most important; the head of a school, or the original sum of money
words.core_concept: the one ranked at the head – 排在头一位的那个
words.core_image: 一张表上第一行印得比别行粗，底下几行都是它的附注
examples: Cost was the principal reason for delay.
The principal called both parents in.
semantic_expansions: 主要的：一堆里分量排最前
校长：学校里位次排最前的人
本金：一笔款里最先那部分，利息由它生出
words.recall_hint: princip（首位）+ -al → 一堆东西里排在头一位的那个，用在人、事、款项上各有说法

words.root_logic: princip（princeps 首位、开端）+ -le → 摆在最前、别的都由它推出来的那一条 → 原则、原理
words.origin: 拉丁语 principium（开端、根本）← princeps（首位者）← primus（第一）
words.native_definition: a basic truth or rule that other things follow from
words.core_concept: the statement put first, from which the rest follows – 摆在最前的那一条，其余由它推出
words.core_image: 一页推演的头一行写着一句话，往下每一步都靠它才立得住
examples: He refused on principle, not for money.
The engine works on a simple principle.
semantic_expansions: 原则/准则：行事时摆在最前的那一条
原理：一套道理里最前那一条，别的推论都从它出

words.root_logic: prior（primus 那一支的比较级：在前的）→ 两者相比更靠前的 → 先前的、优先的
words.origin: 拉丁语 prior（较前的、较早的），与 primus（第一）同出 pri- 一支
words.native_definition: happening or existing before something else, or coming first in order of claim
words.core_concept: the earlier of two compared – 两者相比更早的那一个
words.core_image: 两张单子并排，一张日期早半年，办事的人先拿起早那张
examples: She had no prior experience with boats.
Injured passengers get prior access to care.
semantic_expansions: 先前的：时间上排在前头的
优先的：次序上排在前头，先得到处理

words.root_logic: prior（在前的）+ -ity → 排在前头这一层身份 → 该先办的那件事
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 prioritas（在前的状态）← 拉丁语 prior（较前的）
words.native_definition: the thing that must be dealt with before others, or the right to go first
words.core_concept: being placed ahead of the rest – 被摆到别的前面
words.core_image: 桌上一叠单子被重新码过，有几张抽出来压在最上面
examples: Clean water is the village's first priority.
Ambulances have priority at every crossing.
semantic_expansions: 优先：位次被排到别的前面
优先事项：被排到前面的那件具体事
优先权：这种排前的资格本身

words.root_logic: imag（imago 摹样）+ -e → 与本物相像的那个样子 → 图像；人心里存下的那个样子即形象
words.origin: 古法语 image ← 拉丁语 imaginem（imago 的宾格：摹本、相像之物）
words.native_definition: a picture or likeness of something, or the impression people have of it
words.core_concept: a likeness standing in for the thing – 替本物出面的那个摹样
words.core_image: 镜子里那个人抬手，手也跟着抬，可镜面一擦就只剩一块玻璃
examples: The image on the screen went blurry.
The company wants to change its image.
semantic_expansions: 图像/影像：与本物相像、可看见的那个样子
形象：存在别人心里的那个样子，同样是摹出来的

words.root_logic: imagin（imago 在心里造样）+ -ary → 只在心里造出来、外面没有的 → 想象的
words.origin: 拉丁语 imaginarius（只是摹样的、并非实有的）← imago（摹样）
words.native_definition: existing only in the mind and not in the real world
words.core_concept: made in the mind only, with nothing outside – 只在心里造出，外面没有对应之物
words.core_image: 孩子给空椅子摆了碗筷，还问它要不要添饭
examples: She had an imaginary friend as a child.
The border is an imaginary line on water.
semantic_expansions: 想象的：只在心里成形的
虚构的：同一份「外面没有」用在人物或情节上

words.root_logic: imagin（在心里造样）+ -ation → 在心里造出样子的这份本事
words.origin: 拉丁语 imaginatio（心里造出的样子）← imaginari（在心里造出样子）
words.native_definition: the ability to form pictures or new ideas in the mind
words.core_concept: the power to make a likeness in the mind – 在心里造出样子的本事
words.core_image: 他闭着眼说出每件家具摆在哪，那屋子还没盖起来
examples: The book fired the boy's imagination.
Use your imagination and describe the room.
semantic_expansions: 想象力：造出样子的这份能力
想象：这份能力用起来的那个过程

words.root_logic: imagin（在心里造样）+ -ative → 善于在心里造出样子的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 imaginativus（善于在心里造样的）← imaginari
words.native_definition: good at thinking of new ideas, or showing such thinking
words.core_concept: quick to make new likenesses in the mind – 心里造样造得快又新
words.core_image: 同样几块积木，他搭出来的那个东西谁也没见过
examples: She is an imaginative and careful designer.
It was an imaginative answer to the problem.
semantic_expansions: 富有想象力的：说人善于在心里造出样子
新颖的：同一份本事显在做出来的东西上

words.root_logic: imagin（imago 在心里造样）+ -e → 在心里造出一个样子；造出来的未必真，故也作以为
words.origin: 古法语 imaginer ← 拉丁语 imaginari（在心里造出样子）← imago（摹样）
words.native_definition: to form a picture of something in your mind, or to suppose something
words.core_concept: to make a likeness appear in the mind – 让一个样子在心里浮出来
words.core_image: 闭上眼，先看见门，再看见门后的院子，一样一样浮出来
examples: Imagine a room with no windows at all.
I imagine she has left already.
semantic_expansions: 想象/设想：在心里把样子造出来
以为：心里造出的那个样子被当成了实情

words.root_logic: rat（ratus 算定的）+ -e → 按一定算法定下的那个数；动词即给它定出这个数
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 rata（pars rata「算定的那一份」）← ratus，reri（盘算）的过去分词
words.native_definition: a measured amount or speed, or to judge what level something is at
words.core_concept: the figure worked out by reckoning – 算出来定下的那个数
words.core_image: 水表两次读数相减，除以天数，得出每天走掉多少
examples: The birth rate fell again last year.
Critics rate the film very highly.
semantic_expansions: 比率：两个数算出来的那个数
速度：每单位时间算出来的量
价格：按算法定下的收费
评级：给一样东西算出个位次

words.root_logic: ratio（reri 盘算 → 算出来的账、比数）→ 两个量算出来的那层关系
words.origin: 拉丁语 ratio（算账、比数、道理）← reri（盘算）的过去分词 ratus
words.native_definition: the relation between two amounts, expressed as one number over another
words.core_concept: two amounts set against each other – 两个量相比得出的那个数
words.core_image: 两碗米配一碗水，换个大锅照这个数往上添，稠稀还是一样
examples: The ratio of boys to girls is three to two.
Mix the paint in a one to four ratio.
semantic_expansions: 比率/比例：把两个量放到一起算，得出的那层固定关系

words.root_logic: ration（ratio 算清的道理）+ -al → 按算得清的道理来的
words.origin: 拉丁语 rationalis（有理的、能推算的）← ratio（算账、道理）
words.native_definition: based on clear thinking and reasons rather than on feelings
words.core_concept: going by what the reckoning shows – 照算得清的那一条来
words.core_image: 他把两条路的花费和时间列在纸上，指着数字说走这条
examples: She gave a calm and rational reply.
There is no rational basis for that fear.
semantic_expansions: 理性的：说人凭推算而非凭情绪
合理的：说事经得起推算

words.root_logic: reason（← rationem：算清后得出的道理）→ 说得通的那一条；动词即照这条往下推
words.origin: 古法语 raison ← 拉丁语 rationem（ratio 的宾格：算账、道理）
words.native_definition: the cause of something, the power to think clearly, or to think step by step
words.core_concept: the account that holds up when reckoned – 一算就站得住的那一条
words.core_image: 他一层层往回问，问到最后那句话，屋里的人都不说了
examples: Give me one good reason to wait.
He reasoned from the marks on the floor.
semantic_expansions: 原因/理由：追问下去站得住的那一条
理智：能这样一层层算下去的能力
推理：把这份能力用起来的过程

words.root_logic: reason（算得清的道理）+ -able → 经得起算、说得通的；价钱经得起算即不虚高
words.origin: 古法语 raisonable ← 拉丁语 rationabilis（合于道理的）← ratio
words.native_definition: fair and sensible, or not too expensive
words.core_concept: able to stand up to reckoning – 经得起一算
words.core_image: 他报了个数，买家拿计算器按了一遍，点头掏钱
examples: That seems a reasonable request to me.
They sell good tools at reasonable prices.
semantic_expansions: 合理的：一算就说得通
通情达理的：说人讲得通道理
价钱公道的：同一份「经得起算」用在数目上

words.root_logic: forein（← foranus 在门外的）→ 门外那一边来的 → 外国的
words.origin: 古法语 forain（在外的）← 晚期拉丁语 foranus（在门外的）← 拉丁语 foris（门外）
words.native_definition: belonging to a country other than your own, or not belonging where it is
words.core_concept: coming from outside the door – 从门外那一边来的
words.core_image: 他把证件一递，队伍旁边另开一个窗口，问的问题也换了一套
examples: She speaks three foreign languages well.
The idea felt foreign to everyone there.
semantic_expansions: 外国的：从本国之外来的
外来的：从这个范围之外进来的
陌生的：同一份「不属这里」落在感觉上

words.root_logic: foreign（门外来的）+ -er → 从门外那一边来的人
words.origin: 由 foreign（外国的）加 -er 而成，本源拉丁语 foris（门外）
words.native_definition: a person who comes from another country
words.core_concept: the one who came from outside the door – 从门外那边来的那个人
words.core_image: 他指着菜单上的图点菜，老板笑着比手势报数
examples: Foreigners must register at the local office.
A foreigner asked me for directions today.

words.root_logic: forest（← forestis 圈地之外的林子）→ 门外没人管的那一大片树
words.origin: 古法语 forest ← 中世纪拉丁语 forestis silva（圈地之外的林子）← 拉丁语 foris（门外）；另有一说来自日耳曼语 furhitha（松林），未有定论
words.native_definition: a large area thickly covered with trees
words.core_concept: the wood lying outside the enclosure – 圈地之外那一片树
words.core_image: 往里走了半小时，回头看来路那道口子已经找不着了
examples: They walked all day through the forest.
Fire destroyed part of the forest last summer.
semantic_expansions: 森林：门外那片没人清理的树，连成一大片
林区：同一片树被划成一块地界来说

words.root_logic: forum（本指门外那片敞地）→ 谁都能进来说话的那块地方
words.origin: 拉丁语 forum（门外的敞地，后指集会与市集之所），与 foris（门外）同支
words.native_definition: a place or meeting where people can exchange views openly
words.core_concept: the open ground where any may come and speak – 谁都能进来说话的那片敞地
words.core_image: 空地上摆开几排凳子，想说话的就站到中间那块石台上
examples: The website runs a forum for new parents.
Tourists gather at the ancient forum daily.
semantic_expansions: 论坛：众人都能进来发言的场所，今多指网上的
讨论会：同一块敞地变成一场聚会
古罗马广场：这个词最初指的那片实地

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 朝向）+ compl（com 全 + ple 填满）+ -ish → 把该填的一处处填满
words.origin: 古法语 acomplir ← 通俗拉丁语 accomplere：ad-（朝向）＋complere（填满）← plere（填满）
words.native_definition: to succeed in doing or finishing something you set out to do
words.core_concept: filling in every part that was left open – 把留空的每一处都填上
words.core_image: 清单最后一格也划上钩，笔一放，纸上再没空着的地方
examples: She accomplished the task in two days.
He accomplished what no one else could.
semantic_expansions: 完成：该做的一格格填满，没有剩下的
实现：原先只是打算的那件事被填成了实的

words.root_logic: com-（全）+ ple（填满）+ -te → 处处填满、一处不缺；动词即把它填到满
words.origin: 拉丁语 completus，complere（填满）的过去分词：com-（全）＋plere（填满）
words.native_definition: having all its parts, or to finish making something whole
words.core_concept: filled up until nothing is missing – 填到一处不缺
words.core_image: 拼图最后一块按下去，桌面上再没有露出底板的地方
examples: We have a complete set of records now.
They completed the bridge ahead of time.
semantic_expansions: 完整的：每一处都在，没有缺口
完成：把缺的填上，到齐平为止
彻底的：填得一处不漏，故指程度上到头

words.root_logic: plenti（plenus 满的）+ -ful → 满到有余的
words.origin: 由 plenty（充足）加 -ful 而成，本源拉丁语 plenus（满的）← plere（填满）
words.native_definition: existing in large amounts, more than enough
words.core_concept: filled to the brim and past it – 填到边上还有余
words.core_image: 筐子摆了一地，果子堆到边沿往下滚，捡都捡不完
examples: Fish were plentiful in the river then.
Rain has been plentiful this spring.
semantic_expansions: 丰富的：数量填得满，还往外冒
充足的：填到够用，不必省着

words.root_logic: plen（plenus 满的）+ -ty → 填满之后那个量
words.origin: 古法语 plenté ← 拉丁语 plenitatem（满、充足）← plenus（满的）← plere（填满）
words.native_definition: a large enough amount, as much as is needed or more
words.core_concept: the amount that fills and still leaves extra – 填满之后还余下的那个量
words.core_image: 锅里还剩大半，添完一圈又给每人多舀了一勺
examples: There is plenty of time before the train.
We had plenty to eat that night.
semantic_expansions: 充足：填到够用的那个量
大量：同一个「填得满」偏说数目多

words.origin: 古法语 crime ← 拉丁语 crimen（指控、罪名）
words.native_definition: an act that breaks the law and can be punished
words.core_concept: an act the law will call to account – 会被依法追究的那一桩举动
words.core_image: 橱窗玻璃碎了一地，柜台后面的抽屉全被拉开
examples: The crime was reported the same night.
Crime has fallen in this district.
semantic_expansions: 犯罪：触犯律法这件事本身
罪行：具体那一桩被追究的举动
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 criminalis（与罪名有关的）← 拉丁语 crimen（指控、罪名）
words.native_definition: connected with crime, or a person who has committed one
words.core_concept: having to do with acts the law punishes – 与被律法追究之事相关的
words.core_image: 他被单独带进来，手上还锁着，两侧各站一名法警
examples: He has a criminal record from years ago.
Police caught the criminal near the docks.
semantic_expansions: 犯罪的：与触法之举有关的
刑事的：同一层关系用在法律门类上，与民事相对
罪犯：做下这种举动的那个人
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ crimin（discrimen 分界，出自 cern 筛分）+ -ate → 筛开两样，看出界线；只认一条界线待人即歧视
words.origin: 拉丁语 discriminare（分辨、区别）← discrimen（分界）：dis-（分开）＋cern-（筛分，动词 cerno 一支），与 discern 同出一根
words.native_definition: to tell one thing apart from another, or to treat one group unfairly
words.core_concept: sifting two things apart until the line shows – 筛开两样，直到界线显出来
words.core_image: 两袋米倒在案上，他捏起几粒对着光看，这才把两堆分开做记号
examples: Babies can discriminate between similar sounds.
The law forbids employers to discriminate.
semantic_expansions: 区别/辨别：筛开混杂，把两样的分界看出来
歧视：只认某一条分界就把人分开对待，分界成了待遇之别

words.root_logic: gen（生出、种性）→ 把种性一代代传下去的那个单位
words.origin: 德语 Gen（1909 年由 Pangen 截取而成），本源希腊语 genos（种、出身），与拉丁语 genus 同支
words.native_definition: a unit inside cells that passes a trait from parent to child
words.core_concept: the unit that hands a trait down – 把某个性状传下去的那个单位
words.core_image: 孩子头顶那撮翘起的头发，跟他父亲同一个位置一模一样
examples: This gene controls eye colour in mice.
Scientists located the faulty gene.

words.root_logic: hydro-（水）+ gen（生出）→ 烧起来生成水的那种气
words.origin: 法语 hydrogène（1787 年命名）：希腊语 hydor（水）＋ -genes（生出…的），后者与拉丁语 genus 同支
words.native_definition: the lightest gas of all, which burns to form water
words.core_concept: the gas that makes water when it burns – 一烧就生出水的那种气
words.core_image: 一管无色的气点着，火苗发白，管壁上很快挂了一层水珠
examples: Hydrogen burns with a very pale flame.
The balloon was filled with hydrogen.

words.origin: 近代科学新造词：carbo（拉丁语 carbo 炭）＋hydrate（水化物，来自希腊语 hydor 水），因这类物质由炭与水的成分按比例合成而得名
words.native_definition: a substance in food such as sugar or starch that gives the body energy
words.core_concept: a compound of carbon and water the body burns for energy – 炭与水合成、供身体烧用的那类物质
words.core_image: 半碗米饭下去，跑步时腿上就有劲，不像空着肚子那样发虚
examples: Rice and bread are high in carbohydrate.
Athletes eat carbohydrate before a race.
semantic_expansions: 碳水化合物：按成分命名的那类物质
糖类：同一类东西按日常说法叫的名字
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: pay（← pacare 安抚、摆平）→ 把债主安抚下来，他就不再追 → 付款；名词即所付的那份
words.origin: 古法语 paier（付款，本义安抚债主）← 拉丁语 pacare（安抚、摆平）← pax（相争摆平后的状态）
words.native_definition: to give money for something, or the money given for work
words.core_concept: settling up so the other side presses no further – 结清了，对方不再往下追
words.core_image: 他数出正好的数目推过柜台，对方攥着单子的手松开了
examples: I paid for the tickets in cash.
The pay is low but the work is steady.
semantic_expansions: 付款/支付：把该给的交出去，账就平了
报酬：为出的力所结清的那一份

words.root_logic: pay（pacare 摆平、结清）+ -ment → 结清这件事，或结清时交出的那笔
words.origin: 古法语 paiement ← paier（付款）← 拉丁语 pacare（安抚、摆平）← pax
words.native_definition: the act of paying, or an amount of money paid
words.core_concept: the settling of an account, or the sum that settles it – 把账结清这件事，或结清的那笔数
words.core_image: 收据上盖了章，账本那一行被横着划掉
examples: We received payment three days later.
The first payment is due in May.
semantic_expansions: 付款/支付：结清这个动作本身
款项：结清时交出去的那笔具体数目

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ pay（pacare 结清）→ 往回结清一次 → 偿还；受了好处照样往回结即报答
words.origin: 由 re-（回）加 pay 而成，pay 出自拉丁语 pacare（安抚、摆平）← pax
words.native_definition: to pay back money you owe, or to do something good in return
words.core_concept: settling back in the other direction – 反过来往回结清一次
words.core_image: 他把钱一张张数好推回桌那边，顺手取走那张按了手印的纸
examples: She repaid the loan within a year.
How can I ever repay your kindness?
semantic_expansions: 偿还：借来的钱按原路结回去
报答/回报：受了人的好处，照样往回结一次

words.root_logic: peace（← pacem：相争摆平后的状态）→ 两边都不再往下追的那个局面
words.origin: 古法语 pais ← 拉丁语 pacem（pax 的宾格：相争摆平后的状态）
words.native_definition: a state without war or fighting, or a calm and quiet state
words.core_concept: the state after a dispute is put to rest – 相争摆平之后的那个局面
words.core_image: 刚才还在院里对喊的两个人，现在并排坐在门槛上递烟
examples: The two countries signed a peace treaty.
She read in peace all afternoon.
semantic_expansions: 和平：不再交战的那个局面
平静：摆平之后剩下的那份安静
和睦：人与人之间摆平了，相处不再起争

words.root_logic: peace（pax 摆平之后）+ -ful → 处在谁也不再往下追的那个状态里
words.origin: 由 peace（← 拉丁语 pacem）加 -ful 而成，本源 pax（相争摆平后的状态）
words.native_definition: not involving fighting, or quiet and free from trouble
words.core_concept: in the state where nothing presses further – 处在无人再追的那个状态里
words.core_image: 湖面一丝波纹也没有，桨横搁在船帮上滴水
examples: It was a peaceful protest with no arrests.
We spent a peaceful week by the sea.
semantic_expansions: 和平的：不动武的
平静的：没有起伏动静的
安宁的：同一份「无人再追」落在人的感受上

words.root_logic: plur（plures 更多、多于一）+ -al → 数目多于一的 → 复数的
words.origin: 古法语 plurel ← 拉丁语 pluralis（多于一的）← plus（更多）的复数 plures
words.native_definition: of more than one in number, or the form used for more than one
words.core_concept: of more than one in number – 数目在一以上的
words.core_image: 同一个词后面添上一个字母，说的就不是桌上那一只了
examples: The plural of child is children.
Most nouns take a plural ending in s.
semantic_expansions: 复数的：说数目多于一这个性质
复数：语法里表示多于一的那个形式

words.root_logic: plus（拉丁语「更多」）→ 在原数之上再添 → 加上；添出来的那一项即优势
words.origin: 拉丁语 plus（更多，multus 的比较级）
words.native_definition: with the addition of, or an advantage that counts in favour
words.core_concept: with more added on top – 在原有之上再添一份
words.core_image: 纸上两个数中间划了一个十字形的记号，底下写出合起来的那个数
examples: Two plus three makes five.
Speaking Japanese is a real plus here.
semantic_expansions: 加上：把一个数添到另一个数上
优势：额外多出来的那一项，算起来对你有利

words.root_logic: sur-（越过）+ plus（更多）→ 越过所需之后还多出来的那部分 → 剩余
words.origin: 古法语 surplus：sur-（越过，← 拉丁语 super）＋plus（更多）
words.native_definition: an amount left over after all needs are met, or being left over in this way
words.core_concept: the part standing past what was needed – 越过所需之后还立在那儿的部分
words.core_image: 东西分完，墙角还码着几箱没动，管库的在册子上另记一行
examples: The farm sold its surplus to neighbours.
We store surplus grain in the shed.
semantic_expansions: 剩余：分完之后还余下的那部分
过剩：余得太多，成了要处理的麻烦
多余的：形容某物属于这余下的部分

words.origin: 古法语 cause ← 拉丁语 causa（缘由、案由，也指诉讼中所争之事）
words.native_definition: the thing that makes something happen, or to make it happen
words.core_concept: the thing another thing comes out of – 另一件事由它而出
words.core_image: 一排骨牌立着，指头碰倒最前那张，后面挨着一张张躺下去
examples: Police are looking into the cause of the fire.
Heavy rain caused the delay.
semantic_expansions: 原因：一件事由它而起
导致：由它引出后面那件事，说的是这个动作
事业：值得众人一同去争的那件事，同 causa「所争之事」一路
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 escuser ← 拉丁语 excusare（免去罪责）：ex-（去掉）＋causa（案由、指控）
words.native_definition: to forgive a small fault, or a reason given to avoid blame
words.core_concept: taking the charge off the name of the accused – 把追究从某人身上去掉
words.core_image: 他递上一张纸条，值班的看了两眼，把他的名字从册子上勾掉
examples: Please excuse my late reply.
That is no excuse for shouting.
semantic_expansions: 原谅：把要追究的那笔从对方名下去掉
借口：为脱掉追究而编的那套说法
理由：同样是拿来免责的说法，只是这一条站得住
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出）+ ject（jac 投、扔）→ 往外一扔 → 逐出、弹出
words.origin: 拉丁语 eicere（扔出去）的过去分词 ejectus：ex-（出）＋jacere（投、扔）
words.native_definition: to force someone or something out of a place
words.core_concept: throwing a thing out from inside – 从里头把东西扔出来
words.core_image: 按下那个键，卡嗒一声，盘子自己滑出半截停在那儿
examples: The referee ejected two players.
Press this button to eject the disc.
semantic_expansions: 逐出：把人从场所里扔出去
弹出：机件把里头那物顶出来
喷出：把气或液往外扔出去

words.root_logic: jet（← jactare 反复投扔）→ 被使劲扔出去的那一道 → 喷流；靠往后扔出气流推进的飞机由此得名
words.origin: 古法语 jeter（投、扔）← 通俗拉丁语 jectare ← 拉丁语 jactare（反复投扔）← jacere（投）
words.native_definition: a fast narrow stream of liquid or gas, or a plane driven by such a stream
words.core_concept: a stream thrown out with force – 被使劲扔出去的那一道
words.core_image: 水管破了一道口子，水直挺挺射出去一条，落地才散
examples: A jet of steam shot from the pipe.
We took an overnight jet to Cairo.
semantic_expansions: 喷流/喷射：被压着扔出来的那一道细流
喷气式飞机：靠往后扔出气流把自己推着走的飞机

words.origin: 古法语 enemi ← 拉丁语 inimicus（不友好的）：in-（不）＋amicus（朋友）
words.native_definition: a person or country that is against you and wants to harm you
words.core_concept: the one who is not on your side – 站在你这边之外的那个人
words.core_image: 长桌两头各坐一个，一个把茶杯推倒也不抬头看对面
examples: He made enemies wherever he worked.
The enemy withdrew across the river.
semantic_expansions: 敌人：与你相对、有意加害的一方
仇敌：同一层对立，带着积下的怨
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: hostel/hotel（← hospitale 客舍）→ 接下过路人、给他一处睡的地方 → 旅馆
words.origin: 法语 hôtel ← 古法语 hostel ← 中世纪拉丁语 hospitale（客舍）← hospes（主/客）；与 hospital 同出一词
words.native_definition: a building where travellers pay to sleep and eat
words.core_concept: the house that takes in whoever is passing – 接下过路人的那处屋舍
words.core_image: 登记完，柜台把一把钥匙推过来，行李被人接手拎上楼
examples: We stayed at a small hotel by the station.
The hotel was full that weekend.
semantic_expansions: 旅馆：付钱住一晚的地方
酒店：同一处地方规模大些、兼供饮食的说法

words.root_logic: proof（← proba：验过之后留下的东西）→ 拿去验，验得住的那个凭据
words.origin: 古法语 proeve ← 晚期拉丁语 proba（检验）← 拉丁语 probare（检验、证实）
words.native_definition: something that shows a statement is true
words.core_concept: the thing that holds up when tested – 拿去一验，站得住的那样东西
words.core_image: 他把一叠票据和一张按了手印的纸摊在桌上，刚才争的人不说话了
examples: Do you have any proof of payment?
This is proof that the method works.
semantic_expansions: 证据：验得住、能拿出来的那样东西
证明：同一样东西起的作用，让人认了那句话

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出）+ vok（voc 呼叫）→ 朝里头喊一声，把藏着的叫出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 evocare（召出、唤出）：ex-（出）＋vocare（呼叫）
words.native_definition: to bring a feeling or a memory into the mind of someone
words.core_concept: calling a hidden thing out into the open – 朝里头喊一声，把藏着的叫出来
words.core_image: 一段熟悉的调子刚起头，本来不说话的人开口讲起几十年前的事
examples: The smell evoked the kitchen of her childhood.
His speech evoked strong feelings.
semantic_expansions: 唤起：把心里存着的叫到眼前
引起：同一声呼唤引出一片反应
使人想起：被叫出来的那样东西是旧事

words.root_logic: rota（轮）→ rotare（使轮转）→ 绕着中心一圈圈走
words.origin: 拉丁语 rotare（使旋转）← rota（轮子）
words.native_definition: to turn around a centre point, or to take turns in a fixed order
words.core_concept: to turn about a fixed centre, so each part comes round in turn – 绕固定的中心转，边上每一点依次转到
words.core_image: 轮子架在轴上，手一推，它绕着中心一圈圈走，边上那点走到哪都还回来
examples: The earth rotates once a day.
The nurses rotate night duty.
semantic_expansions: 旋转：绕着中心一圈圈转动
轮流：位置像轮上的点那样依次转到，各人各摊一次
轮换：同一批位置上的人依次替换过来

words.root_logic: rota（轮）→ rotarius（与轮有关的）→ 靠打圈这个动作来干活的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 rotarius（与轮有关的）← 拉丁语 rota（轮子）
words.native_definition: moving in a circle around a centre, or working by turning
words.core_concept: working by going round and round rather than back and forth – 靠打圈运作，不是来回往复
words.core_image: 机器上一个圆盘不停打圈，带着旁边的连杆一下一下动
examples: The rotary blade cut the grass.
A rotary motion drives the pump.
semantic_expansions: 旋转的：整个动作是绕中心打圈
转动的：机件靠这个圈来带动别的部件

words.root_logic: rotula（小轮）→ 古法语 roller（滚）→ 一边翻一边走，或把纸绕成筒
words.origin: 古法语 roller（滚动）← 通俗拉丁语 rotulare ← 拉丁语 rotula（小轮）
words.native_definition: to move along by turning over and over, or a thing wound into a tube
words.core_concept: a thing turned over and over, or wound round on itself – 一样东西不断翻转，或绕着自己卷起来
words.core_image: 球在地上一路翻着往前去；一张纸从一端绕起来，成了个筒
examples: The ball rolled under the car.
Her name was on the roll.
semantic_expansions: 滚动：绕着自己不停翻转着前进
卷：把平的一张绕成筒状的那一卷
名单：名字写在那一卷纸上，念一遍就是点名

words.root_logic: rotula（小轮→纸卷）→ 法语 rôle：演员的台词写在那一卷纸上 → 卷上分给他的那一份
words.origin: 法语 rôle（演员的台词卷）← 古法语 rolle（纸卷）← 拉丁语 rotula（小轮、卷）
words.native_definition: the part someone plays in a situation or a performance
words.core_concept: the one share written out on your own roll of paper – 写在你那一卷纸上、只属于你的那一份
words.core_image: 一卷纸摊开，上面只写着这一个人该说的话、该做的事
examples: She played the role of the queen.
Money has a role in this.
semantic_expansions: 角色：戏里分给你演的那个人
作用：在整件事里你这一份起的效力
职责：卷上写明该由你做的那些事

words.root_logic: en-（进）+ roll（那一卷名册）→ 名字添进卷里 → 从此在册上有你
words.origin: 古法语 enroller（写入名册）← en-（进）+ rolle（纸卷、名册）← 拉丁语 rotula（小轮、卷）
words.native_definition: to put someone's name on an official list, or to join a course
words.core_concept: to get your name added onto the official roll – 让自己的名字被添到那卷正式册子上
words.core_image: 柜台后的人翻开长册，在末尾空着的一行添上你的名字
examples: He enrolled in the evening class.
Two hundred students enrolled.
semantic_expansions: 登记：名字被写进官方那一卷
注册：办完这道手续，身份就算立住
入学：名字进了学校的册子，从此算这里的人

words.root_logic: contra-（对着）+ rotulus（卷册）→ 拿副本对着正册核 → 每一笔都在你手上
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 contreroller（照副册核对）← 中世纪拉丁语 contrarotulus（对照用的副册）← contra（对着）+ rotulus（卷册）← rotula
words.native_definition: to have power over something and decide how it behaves
words.core_concept: to hold the duplicate roll and check every line against it – 手里有一份对照的册子，每一行都核得住
words.core_image: 两本册子并排摊开，他一行行对下来，哪一笔都逃不过
examples: She controls the whole department.
He lost control of the car.
semantic_expansions: 控制：每一项都核得住、也动得了
支配：由此定它往哪走，别人插不上手
管理：照着册子一行行盯下来，事情不出格

words.root_logic: rota（轮）→ rotundus（像轮子那样的）→ 古法语 roont → 轮子的那个形
words.origin: 古法语 roont / reond ← 拉丁语 rotundus（圆的）← rota（轮子）
words.native_definition: shaped like a circle or a ball, or one complete turn of a series
words.core_concept: the shape of a wheel: no corner, and you come back where you started – 轮子那个形：没有棱角，走一圈回到出发处
words.core_image: 盘子边上找不出一处棱角，手指顺着一路摸回起点
examples: She drew a round table.
They talked for three rounds.
semantic_expansions: 圆的：边上处处一样，摸不到棱角
一轮：转满一圈算一次，谈判、酒、比赛都这么数
绕过：顺着那个形从外侧走过去

words.root_logic: sur-（在外面）+ round（圆）→ 在外面合成一圈 → 把里面那个圈在当中
words.origin: 古法语 souronder（漫过、溢出）← 晚期拉丁语 superundare（super 在上 + unda 浪）；进入英语后被 round（圆）重新分析，今天的拼写与「围成一圈」这一常用义都是由 round 来的
words.native_definition: to be all around something on every side
words.core_concept: to close a ring on the outside so the middle has no way out – 在外侧合成一圈，当中那个再无缺口
words.core_image: 一圈人肩挨着肩站定，当中那个往哪边看都是背影
examples: Tall trees surround the house.
Police surrounded the building.
semantic_expansions: 包围：外面合成一圈，里面出不去
环绕：一圈东西围着当中那个铺开

words.root_logic: radius（辐条）→ 轮心到轮缘那一段 → 中心到边上的那段直距离
words.origin: 拉丁语 radius（细杆、车轮辐条、光线）
words.native_definition: the distance from the centre of a circle to its edge
words.core_concept: the one straight stretch from centre to edge – 从中心到边上那一段直距离
words.core_image: 圆规一脚扎在中心，另一脚张开，两脚之间那一段就是量出来的长度
examples: The radius of the circle is five centimetres.
Everything within a two-mile radius was flooded.
semantic_expansions: 半径：圆心到圆周那一段的长度
范围：以一点为心、按这段长度画开去所罩住的一片

words.root_logic: radius（辐条、光线）→ 古法语 rai → 从一点直伸出去的细细一条
words.origin: 古法语 rai ← 拉丁语 radius（辐条、光线）
words.native_definition: a narrow line of light or energy travelling out from its source
words.core_concept: one narrow line running straight out from a bright point – 从一个亮点直直伸出去的细细一条
words.core_image: 窗帘缝里透进细细的一条亮，尘粒排在里头一路飘
examples: A ray of sun came through the crack.
X-rays pass through skin.
semantic_expansions: 光线：从光源直伸出来的那一条
射线：同一个形，用在 X 光那类看不见的能量上
一线：极细的一条，如一线希望

words.root_logic: radius（光线）→ radiare（射出光）→ 现在分词 radiantem → 正往外放光的
words.origin: 拉丁语 radiantem（正在放光的）← radiare（发光）← radius（光线）
words.native_definition: sending out light or warmth, or showing great happiness
words.core_concept: giving off light or heat straight out in all directions – 把光或热朝四面直直放出去
words.core_image: 火炉边不用碰就觉得脸上发烫，那股热是一层层推出来的
examples: Her radiant face lit up the room.
Radiant heat warms the wall.
semantic_expansions: 光芒四射的：光从中心朝各方向直放出去
焕发的：人脸上像有光放出来，一看就知道高兴
辐射的：热或能量以直线向外发散

words.root_logic: radius（辐条）→ radiare（如辐条般伸出）→ 从一点朝四周直伸出去
words.origin: 拉丁语 radiatus ← radiare（放光、如辐条伸展）← radius（辐条、光线）
words.native_definition: to send something out in all directions from a centre
words.core_concept: to go out from one centre along many straight lines at once – 从一个中心同时沿许多直线伸出去
words.core_image: 一块烧红的铁放在桌上，四周的空气都跟着发烫
examples: The stove radiates heat all night.
Five roads radiate from the square.
semantic_expansions: 辐射：热或能量从中心沿直线向外发出
散发：气味、热、情绪像光那样从人身上朝四周出去
呈辐射状伸出：道路、血管从一点像辐条那样分开

words.root_logic: radius（光线）→ radio-（以射线传送）→ 信号像光一样射出去，靠它传话的那东西
words.origin: 由前缀 radio-（← 拉丁语 radius 光线、射线）单独成词，原是「无线电报」一类合成词的前半截——信号像光那样射出去传
words.native_definition: the sending of sound through the air by electric waves, or the box that receives it
words.core_concept: sound sent out through empty air the way light is – 声音像光一样凭空射出去，传到远处
words.core_image: 桌上那只方盒子没接任何线，一开就有人在里头说话
examples: He turned the radio down.
The news came over the radio.
semantic_expansions: 无线电：信号像射线那样穿过空气传送
收音机：接住这种信号、还原成声音的那台机器
广播：用这种方式把话同时送给许多人

words.root_logic: radio-（射线，← radius 光线）+ active（在动作）→ 自己不停往外射东西的
words.origin: radio-（← 拉丁语 radius 光线）+ active；由居里夫妇所用 radioactivité 而来，指物质自行放出射线
words.native_definition: giving off harmful energy because its atoms are breaking down
words.core_concept: a thing that keeps shooting rays out of itself – 一样东西自己不停往外射出射线
words.core_image: 一小块金属封在厚铅罐里，旁边的仪表一直在响
examples: The waste is still radioactive.
They measured radioactive dust.
semantic_expansions: 放射性的：原子自行衰变，不断放出射线
有辐射的：因此周围一圈都受这射线影响

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ plic（折）→ 折着的全摊开 → 没有一处还压在折缝里
words.origin: 拉丁语 explicitus ← explicare（展开、摊平）← ex（出）+ plicare（折）
words.native_definition: stated in full and clear detail, leaving nothing to guess
words.core_concept: folded open all the way, nothing left in the crease – 折缝全摊开，没有一处还盖着
words.core_image: 合同摊平在桌上，每一条都写全了，没有一句要人猜
examples: She gave explicit instructions.
The rules are explicit on this.
semantic_expansions: 明确的：话说全了、条条摊开，无须猜
直言的：该说的不折进话里，直接说出来

words.root_logic: im-（在里面）+ ply（折）→ 意思折在话里面 → 没说出来却夹带着
words.origin: 古法语 emplier ← 拉丁语 implicare（缠进、卷入）← in（进）+ plicare（折）
words.native_definition: to suggest something without saying it directly
words.core_concept: a meaning folded inside the words instead of spread out – 意思折在话里面，没摊开
words.core_image: 他只说了句「你今天倒是很早」，屋里几个人都听出了别的意思
examples: Are you implying that I lied?
Cheap does not imply bad.
semantic_expansions: 暗示：把意思折进话里，让对方自己展开
意味着：一件事里折着另一件，前者成立就带出后者

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ ply（折）→ 话顺着来路折回去 → 对方说完，你折回一句
words.origin: 古法语 replier（折回）← 拉丁语 replicare（折回、重述）← re（回）+ plicare（折）
words.native_definition: to say or write something back to someone
words.core_concept: to fold the words back the way they came – 把话顺着来路折回去
words.core_image: 信读完，他抽出一张纸写了几行，装回信封寄了回去
examples: She replied within an hour.
He gave no reply.
semantic_expansions: 回答：对方问了，你把话折回给他
答复：正式地把处理结果折回去，多用于书面

words.root_logic: multi-（多）+ ply（折）→ 折了很多层 → 一层翻成许多层
words.origin: 古法语 multiplier ← 拉丁语 multiplicare（增多）← multus（多）+ plicare（折）
words.native_definition: to increase a number of times over, or to become much more numerous
words.core_concept: to fold a thing over on itself many times, so one becomes many – 一样东西反复对折，一份变成许多份
words.core_image: 一张纸对折再对折，摊开时格子从一个变成十几个
examples: Multiply seven by eight.
Rabbits multiply fast.
semantic_expansions: 乘：把一个数按另一个数折叠那么多次
增加：数量成倍地翻上去
繁殖：一代折出许多代，数量翻着长

words.root_logic: sim-（一）+ ple（折）→ simplex：只折一道 → 层数少，一眼看到底
words.origin: 古法语 simple ← 拉丁语 simplex（单一的）← sim-（一）+ plicare（折）——只有一折
words.native_definition: having few parts or steps, and easy to understand or do
words.core_concept: folded only once, so the whole of it shows at a glance – 只折了一道，整个结构一眼看得完
words.core_image: 一张纸只对折过一次，翻开就一道印，一眼看清它是怎么来的
examples: The rule is simple enough.
She wore a simple grey dress.
semantic_expansions: 简单的：层数少、步骤少，容易懂容易做
朴素的：没有多加的花样，就那一层
单纯的：心里没有折来折去的弯，想的就是说的

words.root_logic: ekhein（持、按住）→ skholē（把活计按下来腾出的闲时）→ 用这段时间讲学的地方
words.origin: 古英语 scōl ← 拉丁语 schola ← 希腊语 skholē（闲暇、讲学处）← ekhein（持、按住）——把手上的活按下来腾出的那段时间
words.native_definition: a place where children or students are taught
words.core_concept: time held back from work, and the place that time is spent – 从劳作里按下来的那段时间，以及花掉它的地方
words.core_image: 外头田里正忙，一排孩子却坐在屋里，手上没活，只有书
examples: The children walk to school.
He belongs to the old school.
semantic_expansions: 学校：把活按下、专用来受教的地方
学院：大学里按科目分开的一处
流派：同一处受教出来的一批人，看法相近

words.root_logic: skholē（讲学处）→ scholaris（属于讲学处的人）→ 把腾出的时间全花在学问上的人
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 scholaris（属于学校的人）← 拉丁语 schola ← 希腊语 skholē ← ekhein（持、按住）
words.native_definition: a person who studies a subject deeply, or a student holding a grant
words.core_concept: the one who spends all the held-back time on study – 把扣下来的那段时间全花在学问上的人
words.core_image: 一个人在书堆里坐了二十年，别的活一样没干过
examples: She is a scholar of ancient Greek.
He went to Oxford as a scholar.
semantic_expansions: 学者：终身把时间用在一门学问上的人
奖学金生：靠成绩得到资助、被供着专心念书的学生

words.root_logic: ekhein（持）→ skhēma（被持成的形、格局）→ 事先在纸上定好的那个格局
words.origin: 拉丁语 schema（形状、图式）← 希腊语 skhēma（样子、格局）← ekhein（持）
words.native_definition: an organized plan for doing something, sometimes a dishonest one
words.core_concept: the shape a thing is held in, set down in advance – 一样东西被安排成的格局，事先就定死
words.core_image: 一张纸上画着方框和箭头，哪一步接哪一步都标死了
examples: The council approved the scheme.
They schemed to take his land.
semantic_expansions: 计划：事先把步骤摆成一个固定格局
方案：这个格局写下来交人看的成品
阴谋：同样是摆好的格局，只是摆的人不打算让你知道

words.root_logic: epi-（在上）+ ekhein（按住）→ epokhē（被按停的那一点）→ 从那一点起另算的一段
words.origin: 希腊语 epokhē（停住、定点）← epi（在上）+ ekhein（按住）——把连着走的时间按停，从那一点起另算
words.native_definition: a long period of history marked off by something important
words.core_concept: a point where time is held still and counting starts over – 时间被按停的那一点，从此重新起算
words.core_image: 年表上划下一道线，线左边是一种活法，右边完全是另一种
examples: The invention began a new epoch.
Rome fell at the end of that epoch.
semantic_expansions: 时代：被大事切出来的一长段，前后活法不同
纪元：从被按停的那一点起算的计年起点

words.root_logic: mille passuum（一千双步）→ 古英语 mīl → 一千步那么长的一段路
words.origin: 古英语 mīl ← 拉丁语 mille passuum（一千双步）——古罗马以一千双步为一里
words.native_definition: a unit of distance equal to about 1.6 kilometres
words.core_concept: the length that a thousand paces come to – 一千步走出来的那段长度
words.core_image: 路边石头一块块过去，走到第一千步那块才算走完一段
examples: The town is three miles away.
We walked for miles.
semantic_expansions: 英里：约合一点六公里的长度单位
一大段路：口语里拿它泛指很远，如 walked for miles

words.root_logic: mille（一千）+ -one（加大）→ 意大利语 milione：一个「大号的千」→ 一千个千
words.origin: 意大利语 milione（大的一千）← mille（一千）+ 加大后缀 -one
words.native_definition: the number 1,000,000
words.core_concept: a thousand thousands, the thousand made big – 一千个一千，被放大过的那个千
words.core_image: 一千个口袋，每袋装一千颗豆子，全堆在一间屋里
examples: The city has two million people.
I have a million things to do.
semantic_expansions: 百万：一千乘一千得出的那个数
无数：口语里拿这个数泛指多得数不清

words.root_logic: million（一千个千）+ -aire（持有者）→ 家当要用这个数来点的人
words.origin: 法语 millionnaire ← million（百万）+ -aire（持有者）← 拉丁语 mille（一千）
words.native_definition: a person who has at least a million pounds or dollars
words.core_concept: the one whose money is counted in big thousands – 家当要拿「千个千」来数的那个人
words.core_image: 他名下的数字后面跟着六个零，房子车子都不用先问价
examples: Her uncle is a millionaire.
He became a millionaire at thirty.
semantic_expansions: 百万富翁：资产达到一百万的人
大富豪：由此泛指极有钱的人

words.root_logic: milli-（千分之一，← mille 一千）+ metre（米，← metron 量度）→ 一米切成一千格，取其中一格
words.origin: 法语 millimètre，由拉丁语 mille（一千）＋希腊语 metron（量度）合成
words.native_definition: a unit of length equal to one thousandth of a metre
words.core_concept: one of the thousand parts a metre is cut into – 一米均分成一千份里的一份
words.core_image: 钢尺上一米被切成一千格，最细的那一格几乎看不清刻线
examples: The gap is only two millimeters wide.
Ten millimeters of rain fell in an hour.

words.root_logic: a-（离开）+ vert（转）→ 把脸或事头转开 → 不让它撞上来
words.origin: 拉丁语 avertere（转开、避开）← ab（离开）+ vertere（转）
words.native_definition: to turn something away, or to stop something bad from happening
words.core_concept: to turn a thing aside so that it never arrives – 把它转向一边，让它到不了
words.core_image: 车头眼看要撞上，他猛地把方向盘往旁边一带
examples: Quick thinking averted a crash.
She averted her eyes.
semantic_expansions: 避免：把要撞上来的事转开，使它不发生
转移开：把目光或注意从这边转到别处

words.root_logic: annus（年）+ vers（转）→ 年头转满一圈又落回同一天
words.origin: 拉丁语 anniversarius（一年一转的）← annus（年）+ versus（转，vertere 的过去分词）
words.native_definition: the day in each year when you remember something that happened
words.core_concept: the year turning right round to the very same day – 年份转满一圈，又落回同一天
words.core_image: 日历翻了一整圈，又翻到那一格，格子上还留着去年画的圈
examples: Today is their tenth anniversary.
They marked the anniversary quietly.
semantic_expansions: 周年：满一年整，日子转回原处
纪念日：转回来的那一天专用来记那件事

words.root_logic: contra-（对着）+ vers（转）→ 两边都转过来对着 → 各执一词僵着
words.origin: 拉丁语 controversia ← controversus（转过来相对的）← contra（对着）+ versus（转，vertere 的过去分词）
words.native_definition: a long public argument in which people strongly disagree
words.core_concept: two sides turned to face each other and neither gives way – 两边转过来正对着，谁也不让
words.core_image: 两拨人在报纸上来回登文章，谁也不肯先收声
examples: The plan caused great controversy.
The book is still a controversy.
semantic_expansions: 争议：一件事上众人转成对立的两面，公开僵着
争论：这两面来回交锋的那个过程

words.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ vers（转）→ prorsus（一路朝前、不折回）→ 写到行末不转回，接着往下走
words.origin: 古法语 prose ← 拉丁语 prosa oratio（直说的话）← prorsus ← proversus（朝前转的）← pro（向前）+ vertere（转）——与诗在行末折回相对
words.native_definition: ordinary written language, not arranged in lines of poetry
words.core_concept: words running straight on, never turning back at a line's end – 话一路朝前走，不在行末折回
words.core_image: 一段字从左顶到右，一行满了接着下一行，没人管它在哪儿断
examples: He writes prose, not poetry.
The prose is plain and clear.
semantic_expansions: 散文：不分行、不押韵的普通文字
平铺直叙的文字：由此引申指没有起伏、只一路说下去的文句

words.root_logic: honos（众人给的看重）→ 得着这份看重，或把它给出去
words.origin: 古法语 honor ← 拉丁语 honor / honos（体面、众人的看重）
words.native_definition: great respect given to someone, or the giving of it
words.core_concept: the regard a crowd gives, and the act of giving it – 众人给出的那份看重，以及给出它这个动作
words.core_image: 全场的人一齐站起来，掌声一直等到他坐下才停
examples: It was an honor to meet her.
They honored him with a medal.
semantic_expansions: 荣誉：从众人那里得到的看重本身
尊敬：把这份看重给出去的态度
履行：把承诺当成要守的体面，照数兑现

words.root_logic: honos（体面）+ -estus（配得上的）→ honestus：拿得出去见人的 → 不藏不假
words.origin: 古法语 honeste ← 拉丁语 honestus（体面的、配得上敬重的）← honos
words.native_definition: telling the truth and not cheating anyone
words.core_concept: fit to be looked at by anyone, so nothing needs hiding – 经得起众人看，所以没什么要藏
words.core_image: 账本摊开随人翻，哪一页都不用事先抽走
examples: Give me an honest answer.
She is honest about money.
semantic_expansions: 诚实的：说的就是真的，不掺假
正直的：做的事也经得起看，不走暗路

words.root_logic: honos（看重）+ -abilis（可…的）→ 值得旁人给出这份看重的
words.origin: 古法语 honorable ← 拉丁语 honorabilis（值得敬重的）← honorare ← honos
words.native_definition: deserving respect because of fair and decent behaviour
words.core_concept: worth the regard that a crowd would give – 配得上众人那份看重
words.core_image: 他本可以不认那笔旧账，最后还是一分不少地还了
examples: He made an honorable choice.
It was an honorable defeat.
semantic_expansions: 光荣的：这件事本身值得众人看重
可敬的：做这事的人因此值得旁人敬重

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ par（相等）→ 把两样摆到同一水平上 → 横着看差在哪
words.origin: 拉丁语 comparare（并列、比较）← com（一起）+ par（相等的）
words.native_definition: to look at two things together to see how they are alike or different
words.core_concept: to set two things on one level and look across – 把两样摆到同一水平上，横着看过去
words.core_image: 两块布并排摊在光下，一寸寸挨着看颜色差多少
examples: Compare the two answers carefully.
Nothing compares with home.
semantic_expansions: 比较：并排摆开，逐处看异同
相比：拿一样对着另一样衡量高下

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ par（相等）+ -ison（名词）→ 把两样摆平了看这件事
words.origin: 古法语 comparaison ← 拉丁语 comparationem ← comparare ← com（一起）+ par（相等的）
words.native_definition: the act of looking at two things together to see how they differ
words.core_concept: the act of putting two on one level to see the gap – 把两样摆平了看差距这件事
words.core_image: 一张表分左右两栏，每一行左边填一个数、右边填一个数
examples: The comparison is not fair.
Draw a comparison between them.
semantic_expansions: 比较：把两者并列衡量的那个过程
对比：把差异摆出来的那种并列，重在显出不同

words.root_logic: par（相等）→ 古法语 per（同等的人）→ 与你站在同一层上的人
words.origin: 古法语 per（同等的人）← 拉丁语 par（相等的）
words.native_definition: a person of the same age, rank, or ability as another
words.core_concept: the one standing on your own level, neither above nor below – 站在与你同一层上的人，不高不低
words.core_image: 一排座位上的人年纪相当、职级相当，谁也不必先向谁点头
examples: He is respected by his peers.
Teenagers feel peer pressure.
semantic_expansions: 同龄人：年纪与你相当的人
同辈：辈分、资历与你相当的人
同等地位的人：职级或身份与你平齐的人，如同行评议

words.root_logic: poiein（造）→ poiētēs（造的人）→ 拿词当料造东西的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 poete ← 拉丁语 poeta ← 希腊语 poiētēs（制作者）← poiein（做、造）
words.native_definition: a person who writes poems
words.core_concept: the maker, only his material is words – 手艺人，只是他的料是词
words.core_image: 他为一行字里的一个词换了七遍，像木匠在找一块合缝的料
examples: The poet read to a small crowd.
She is a better poet than critic.

words.root_logic: poiein（造）→ poiēma（造出来的那件东西）→ 用词造成的那一件成品
words.origin: 拉丁语 poema ← 希腊语 poiēma（做成之物）← poiein（做、造）
words.native_definition: a piece of writing in lines, chosen for its sound and rhythm
words.core_concept: the thing made, when the material is words – 造出来的那件成品，用的料是词
words.core_image: 半页纸上二十来行字，每行长短都掐过，念出来有轻有重
examples: He wrote a poem about the sea.
The poem is only eight lines.
semantic_expansions: 诗：用词造成的那一件，讲究分行与声音
诗歌：泛指这一类作品，或与歌相连的那一种

words.root_logic: poiein（造）→ poeta（造的人）→ poetria：这门手艺，以及它做出来的全部
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 poetria ← 拉丁语 poeta ← 希腊语 poiētēs ← poiein（做、造）
words.native_definition: poems taken as a whole, or the art of writing them
words.core_concept: the craft of making with words, and everything it has made – 用词做东西这门手艺，以及做出来的全部
words.core_image: 书架上整整一层都是分行的书，从荷马一路排到今年
examples: She teaches poetry at the college.
There is poetry in his letters.
semantic_expansions: 诗歌：这一类作品的总称
诗艺：把词造成诗的那门手艺本身

words.root_logic: cep（拿取、接过）→ acater（去买进来）→ 替一场宴席把吃的采买齐 → 备好别人要的
words.origin: 英语 caterer 的回构动词 ← 古北法语 acatour（采买人）← acater（买进）← 通俗拉丁语 accaptare ← ad + captare ← capere（拿取）
words.native_definition: to provide food for an event, or to provide what someone needs
words.core_concept: to go and take in what other people are going to need – 替别人把要用的东西买进来备着
words.core_image: 宴席前一天，他一车车把菜拉进后厨，按人头点了数
examples: They catered our wedding.
The hotel caters for families.
semantic_expansions: 承办酒席：把宴席要的食物采买齐、送到场
迎合：把对方想要的先备好递上去
满足需求：泛指为某类人备齐他们要的那些东西

words.root_logic: pur-（向前，即 pro）+ chase（追，← capere 拿取）→ 一路追着，把它拿到手 → 花钱买下
words.origin: 古法语 porchacier（追求、设法取得）← pur-（向前）+ chacier（追，← 通俗拉丁语 captiare ← capere 拿取）
words.native_definition: to buy something, especially something large or costly
words.core_concept: to chase a thing down until it is in your hands – 一路追着，直到它落进你手里
words.core_image: 他看中那台机器，跑了三趟、谈了价，最后签字提货
examples: She purchased the house last year.
Keep your receipt for every purchase.
semantic_expansions: 购买：追着谈成、付钱把东西拿到手
所购之物：这样拿到手的那件东西本身

words.root_logic: pila（柱、垛）→ 一样样往上码，越码越高 → 立着的那一垛
words.origin: 古法语 pile（一堆、垛）← 拉丁语 pila（石柱、垛）
words.native_definition: a number of things lying one on top of another, or to put them so
words.core_concept: things laid one on another until they stand up as one lot – 一样样叠上去，最后成为立着的一垛
words.core_image: 书一本压一本码到齐胸高，最上面那本一碰就要滑下来
examples: A pile of letters waited for him.
She piled the plates in the sink.
semantic_expansions: 堆：一样样叠起来形成的那一垛
摞：偏指叠得整齐的那一叠
堆积：不断往上叠、越积越多这个过程

words.root_logic: pila（石柱）→ 古法语 piler → 一根立着顶住上面重量的柱
words.origin: 古法语 piler ← 中世纪拉丁语 pilare ← 拉丁语 pila（石柱、垛）
words.native_definition: a tall upright post that holds up part of a building
words.core_concept: one upright stack of stone taking the weight above – 立着的一垛石头，顶着上面的重量
words.core_image: 殿前一排石头立着，屋顶整个压在它们头上
examples: Stone pillars hold up the roof.
She is a pillar of the community.
semantic_expansions: 柱子：立着承重的那一根
支柱：由此引申指一件事赖以站住的关键部分
栋梁：指人，某个群体全靠他撑着

words.root_logic: col-（一起）+ loc（地点）→ collocare（安放到位）→ coucher（放躺下）→ 供人躺下的那件家具
words.origin: 古法语 couche（卧处）← coucher（使躺下）← 拉丁语 collocare（安置）← com（一起）+ locare（放）← locus（地点）
words.native_definition: a long soft seat for two or more people to sit or lie on
words.core_concept: the place a body gets laid down – 把身子安放下来的那一处
words.core_image: 客厅靠墙那件长长的软家具，人一坐下就往后陷
examples: He fell asleep on the couch.
They pushed the couch to the wall.
semantic_expansions: 长沙发：客厅里供多人坐卧的那件长软座
卧榻：偏指专供躺卧的那种，如诊室里的诊床

words.root_logic: publicus（属于众人的）→ public house（对众人开门的屋子）→ 截短成 pub
words.origin: public house（公众可入的酒馆）的截短形 ← 拉丁语 publicus（属于民众的）← populus（人民）
words.native_definition: a building where people go to drink beer and talk
words.core_concept: the house whose door stands open to anyone – 那间对谁都开着门的屋子
words.core_image: 街角一扇门谁都能推开，里面木桌旁坐满了下班的人
examples: They met at the pub after work.
The pub closes at eleven.
semantic_expansions: 酒馆：对公众开放、卖酒供人聚坐的地方
小酒吧：规模不大的这类去处，英国街区常见

words.origin: 拉丁语 elaboratus ← elaborare（费工做出来）← ex（出来）+ laborare（劳作）← labor（劳苦）
words.native_definition: having many carefully worked parts, or to add more detail to something
words.core_concept: worked over at length until every part shows the effort – 费足了工夫做出来，每一处都看得见下过的功
words.core_image: 一只木盒每一面都刻满花纹，边角还嵌了细银丝
examples: She wore an elaborate headdress.
Could you elaborate on that point?
semantic_expansions: 精心制作的：处处下过工夫，细节做足
详尽的：内容也一样做足，条条铺开
详细说明：把已说的再往细处做一层
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语 laboratory 的截短形 ← 中世纪拉丁语 laboratorium（做工的屋子）← laborare（劳作）
words.native_definition: a room fitted out for scientific work
words.core_concept: the room set aside just for doing the work – 专门腾出来做那件事的一间屋
words.core_image: 长台上一排玻璃器皿，穿白衣的人低头看刻度
examples: The samples are still in the lab.
She works in a language lab.
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 brace（两臂张开之长）← 拉丁语 bracchia（两条手臂，bracchium 的复数）
words.native_definition: something that holds parts firmly in place, or to get ready for a shock
words.core_concept: two arms thrown round a thing to hold it steady – 两条胳膊环上去，把东西箍住不动
words.core_image: 墙上裂了缝，工人斜着钉上两根木条把它顶住
examples: A metal brace held the beam.
Brace yourself for bad news.
semantic_expansions: 支撑物：钉上去把东西固定住的那一件
绷紧：像两臂用力那样把自己收紧
撑住：预先绷住身子，迎接要来的冲撞
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: ad-（靠近）+ sist（站立）→ 站到旁边去搭手
words.origin: 拉丁语 assistere：ad-（靠近）+ sistere（站立）；sistere 与 stare 同源
words.native_definition: to help someone do something
words.core_concept: standing beside someone to lend a hand – 站到人旁边搭上一只手
words.core_image: 他一个人搬不动，另一个人走到旁边搭上一只手，一起抬起来
examples: A nurse assisted the surgeon.
He assisted me with the forms.
semantic_expansions: 协助/帮助：站到旁边去搭手，出力的是次要那一方

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ sist（站立）→ 若干成分一起立住成为整体
words.origin: 拉丁语 consistere：com-（一起）+ sistere（站立）；sistere 与 stare 同源
words.native_definition: to be made up of certain parts
words.core_concept: several parts standing together as one thing – 几个成分一起立住成为一件
words.core_image: 拆开看是三样东西，合起来立在那儿才是一件完整的
examples: Water consists of hydrogen and oxygen.
Her charm consists in her honesty.
semantic_expansions: 由...组成：若干成分一起立着构成整体
在于：要害就立在那一处，不在别处

words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ sta（立）→ 两者分开各立一处 → 中间隔出的那一段
words.origin: 古法语 destance ← 拉丁语 distantia ← distare：dis-（分开）+ stare（站立）
words.native_definition: the amount of space between two points
words.core_concept: the space left between two things standing apart – 两物各立一处，中间空出的那段
words.core_image: 两根桩子各钉一头，中间那段拿绳量出来有多长
examples: The distance between the towns is short.
She kept her distance from him.
semantic_expansions: 距离：两点之间空出的那段长度
远处：那段长到看不清那头
疏远：人和人之间也空出这么一段

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ sist（站立）→ 立出来能被看见 → 是有这么一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 existere：ex-（出来）+ sistere（站立）；sistere 与 stare 同源
words.native_definition: to be real or present in the world
words.core_concept: standing out where it can be found – 立出来、找得到
words.core_image: 传说里的那种鸟，有人真在林子里拍到了一张
examples: Dragons do not exist.
Some families exist on very little.
semantic_expansions: 存在：立在世上能被找到
生存：勉力立着不倒下

words.root_logic: exist（立出来）+ -ence → 立在世上这个状态
words.origin: 古法语 existence ← 晚期拉丁语 existentia ← existere：ex-（出来）+ sistere（站立）
words.native_definition: the state of being real or of staying alive
words.core_concept: the state of standing out in the world – 立在世上这个状态
words.core_image: 名册上有这一栏，写着他从哪年起在这世上
examples: They doubted the existence of life there.
He led a lonely existence.
semantic_expansions: 存在：立在世上这件事本身
生存：立着不倒的那种日子

words.root_logic: in-（在上）+ sist（站立）→ 死死站在那一点上不挪
words.origin: 拉丁语 insistere：in-（在上）+ sistere（站立）；sistere 与 stare 同源
words.native_definition: to say or demand something firmly and repeatedly
words.core_concept: planting oneself on one point and not moving off it – 站定在一点上不肯挪
words.core_image: 别人都改口了，他还站在原处把那句话又说了一遍
examples: She insisted that he was wrong.
He insisted on paying the bill.
semantic_expansions: 坚持：站在那一点上不挪
坚决要求：站着不挪并要对方照办

words.root_logic: per-（贯穿到底）+ sist（站立）→ 一路站到底不倒
words.origin: 拉丁语 persistere：per-（贯穿）+ sistere（站立）；sistere 与 stare 同源
