words.native_definition: to keep on doing something, or to continue to exist
words.core_concept: standing through to the end without going down – 一路站到底没倒
words.core_image: 雨下了三天没停，那面旗还在杆上没被打下来
examples: He persisted despite every setback.
The smell persisted for weeks.
semantic_expansions: 坚持：人一路站到底不放手
持续存在：现象也一样立着不散

words.root_logic: sub-（在下）+ sta（立）→ 立在底下托着表象的那个东西
words.origin: 古法语 substance ← 拉丁语 substantia ← substare：sub-（在下）+ stare（站立）
words.native_definition: a material with particular qualities; the most important part of something
words.core_concept: what stands underneath and holds the thing up – 立在底下把整件托住的那个
words.core_image: 刮掉外面那层漆，底下托着整件东西的那块料露出来
examples: A sticky substance covered the floor.
The substance of his talk was simple.
semantic_expansions: 物质：立在底下的那块料
实质：撑着表象的那个内核
要点：一段话里真正托着它的那句

words.root_logic: ab-（离开）+ sent（esse 在）→ 不在这儿；与 praesens（在眼前）正好一对
words.origin: 拉丁语 absentem ← absens，abesse（不在）的现在分词，由 ab-（离开）＋ esse（是、在）构成
words.native_definition: not in the place where one is expected to be
words.core_concept: the seat where someone should be found is empty – 该找到人的那个位子空着
words.core_image: 点名一路点下去，第三排那个位子空着，本子还摊在桌上
examples: Two students were absent today.
He had an absent look on his face.
semantic_expansions: 缺席的：该来的人没到
不在的：那个位子上没有他
心不在焉的：人在座上，心不在这儿

words.root_logic: ent（esse 的现在分词 ens：在着的）+ -ity → 在着的那一个，自成一个的东西
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 entitas ← ens（属格 entis：存在物），是 esse（是、在）的现在分词
words.native_definition: something that exists separately from other things
words.core_concept: a thing that stands on its own as one – 自己成一个、不并进别处的那一个
words.core_image: 表格上把这家公司单独列一行，账目和别处不混，出事也只找它
examples: The company is a separate legal entity.
They treat each branch as one entity.
semantic_expansions: 实体：能单独算一个、独立在着的那样东西
独立存在物：与别的分得开、自成一份的那个

words.root_logic: ess（esse 是、在）+ -ence → 一样东西「是它自己」所靠的那一点
words.origin: 古法语 essence ← 拉丁语 essentia（存在、本性），由 esse（是、在）造出
words.native_definition: the quality that makes something what it is; a concentrated extract
words.core_concept: what is left when everything else is taken away – 别的都去掉之后剩下的那一点
words.core_image: 一筐花瓣熬到最后剩小半瓶，味道比整筐还冲
examples: Freedom is the essence of democracy.
Add a few drops of vanilla essence.
semantic_expansions: 本质：去掉外面一切、它还是它所靠的那点
精华：一大堆里提出来的那一小份
香精：提到浓得发冲的那瓶

words.root_logic: ess（esse 是、在）+ -ential → 关乎它「是不是它」的 → 少了就不成的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 essentialis ← essentia（存在、本性）← esse（是、在）
words.native_definition: so important that something cannot work or exist without it
words.core_concept: the part you cannot take out and still have the thing – 抽掉它这东西就不成立了
words.core_image: 清单上划掉几样还照样出发，划到那一样时手停住了，没它根本走不了
examples: Water is essential to all life.
Read the essential facts first.
semantic_expansions: 必不可少的：少了它整件事办不成
本质的：关乎它到底是不是它的那一层

words.root_logic: inter-（在两者之间）+ est（esse 在）→ 这事横在我这边，与我有牵连
words.origin: 古法语 interest ← 拉丁语 interest（interesse 的第三人称：夹在中间、有关系），由 inter（在中间）＋ esse（是、在）构成
words.native_definition: a feeling of wanting to know more; an advantage or share; money paid for a loan
words.core_concept: a thing that stands between you and it, so it concerns you – 那事与你之间有一层牵连，于事关己
words.core_image: 本来是别人的事，说到一半提到他家那块地，他把椅子往前挪了挪
examples: She has a strong interest in history.
The loan carries high interest.
semantic_expansions: 兴趣：牵连一旦搭上，人就想多知道
利益：牵连里落到自己这边的那份好处
利息：借出的钱与人之间那份牵连按时结出的数
使感兴趣：把这层牵连搭到别人身上

words.root_logic: im-（不）+ medi（medius 中间）+ -ate → 中间不隔任何东西 → 挨着的、当下的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 immediatus：in-（不）＋ mediatus（居间的）← medius（居中的）
words.native_definition: happening or done at once; nearest in space or relation
words.core_concept: with nothing standing in the middle – 中间不隔一层，直接挨上
words.core_image: 手指刚碰到开关，灯就亮了，中间没有一点空隙
examples: We need an immediate answer.
Only immediate family members attended the service.
semantic_expansions: 立即的：时间上中间不隔一点空
直接的：中间不经别人转手
最接近的：位置或关系上贴着的那一圈

words.root_logic: inter-（在两者之间）+ medi（medius 中间）+ -ate → 正落在两头之间那一档
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 intermediatus ← 拉丁语 intermedius：inter（在中间）＋ medius（居中的）
words.native_definition: coming between two levels, stages, or places
words.core_concept: the step that sits between the low one and the high one – 夹在低的那档与高的那档中间的一级
words.core_image: 三级台阶，他站在当中那级，上一级和下一级都伸手可及
examples: She joined the intermediate class.
We stopped at an intermediate station.
semantic_expansions: 中级的：程度上不高不低的那一档
中间的：位置上夹在两处之间的那一处

words.root_logic: mean（medianus 居中的）+ while（一段时间）→ 夹在两件事之间那段时间里
words.origin: 中古英语 mean（← 古法语 meien ← 晚期拉丁语 medianus 居中的 ← medius）＋ 古英语 hwīl（一段时间）
words.native_definition: during the same period of time; at the same time
words.core_concept: the stretch of time lying in between – 夹在两头之间那一段时间里
words.core_image: 锅在灶上咕咕响着，她趁这段工夫把碗一只只擦干
examples: Meanwhile, the others waited outside.
You can read the notes meanwhile.
semantic_expansions: 同时：两件事占着同一段时间
与此同时：说完这头，另一头在同一段时间里也在动

words.root_logic: medi（medius 中间）+ ev（aevum 时代）+ -al → 属于中间那个时代的
words.origin: 近代拉丁语 medievalis ← medium aevum（中间的时代），由 medius（居中的）＋ aevum（时代）合成
words.native_definition: belonging to the period between ancient and modern times
words.core_concept: belonging to the age that lies between the old and the new – 属于夹在古与今之间那个时代
words.core_image: 石头城墙上留着箭孔，护城河的水面漂着落叶，桥板还能吱呀地放下来
examples: The town has a medieval castle.
He studies medieval church music now.
semantic_expansions: 中世纪的：属于古今之间那一大段时期
中古的：那一段里的做法与样式

words.root_logic: medium（medius 的中性名词：居中之物）→ 居中那一档；夹在两头之间传东西的那个
words.origin: 拉丁语 medium（中间、中介）是 medius（居中的）的中性名词形
words.native_definition: a means by which something is passed on; a middle level or size
words.core_concept: what sits between two ends and carries across – 夹在两头之间、靠它过去的那个
words.core_image: 两间屋隔着一道墙，话是靠管子从这头传到那头的
examples: Television is a powerful medium.
He wears a medium shirt.
semantic_expansions: 媒介：夹在两头之间把东西递过去的那个
中等的：不大不小、落在当中那一档
手段：借它到达那一头的那个

words.root_logic: a-（向）+ ward（wardon 看守、审视）→ 审看过之后把东西递到该得的那个人手上
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 awarder（裁定）：a-（向）＋ warder，是古法语 guarder（看守、审视）的诺曼变体 ← 法兰克语 *wardon
words.native_definition: a prize given for something done well; to give such a prize officially
words.core_concept: looked over and then handed to the one who earned it – 看过一遍，再把东西递给该得的那个
words.core_image: 几个人把稿子看了两遍，抬头对了一下眼神，把那只小铜像推到其中一人面前
examples: She won an award for her novel.
The judge awarded him damages.
semantic_expansions: 奖：审看之后递过去的那样东西
授予：正式地把它递到那人手上
判给：审断之后归到某一方名下

words.root_logic: guard（wardon 看守）→ 眼睛盯住一处不移开，不让人进去
words.origin: 古法语 guarde/guarder（看守）← 法兰克语 *wardon（守望、看顾），与英语 ward 同出此支
words.native_definition: to keep something safe by watching it; a person who does this
words.core_concept: eyes fixed on one place so nothing gets past – 眼睛钉在一处，谁也过不去
words.core_image: 门口那人站了一夜没坐下，谁往里走都被伸手拦一下
examples: Two men guarded the gate.
Be on your guard at night.
semantic_expansions: 守卫：把眼睛盯住一处不让人过
看守：干这件事的那个人
警惕：心里也这么盯着，不放松

words.root_logic: re-（回过来）+ ward（wardon 看顾）→ 看见他做了什么，拿东西回过去
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 rewarder（回看、酬答）：re-（回）＋ warder，是古法语 guarder（看守）的诺曼变体 ← 法兰克语 *wardon
words.native_definition: something given in return for good work or help
words.core_concept: seeing what someone did and sending something back – 看见他做的，再把东西回过去
words.core_image: 他把丢的钱包送回来，主人回屋取了一样东西塞进他手里
examples: He got a reward for his honesty.
Hard work rewards you later.
semantic_expansions: 报酬：因他做过的事回过去的那一份
奖赏：分量更重、当众给的那一份
酬谢：把这份心意回到人身上

words.root_logic: ward（wardon 看守）→ 被看着的那一片地方，或被看着的那个人
words.origin: 古英语 weard（守望、看守），与法兰克语 *wardon 同出原始日耳曼语一支，故与 guard 同源
words.native_definition: a room in a hospital with several beds; a person under someone's legal care
words.core_concept: the space or person kept under watch – 被看着的那一片，或被看着的那一个
words.core_image: 白大褂推门进来，一排床挨着摆，她在每张床脚停一下看一眼
examples: She works in the children's ward.
The boy became a ward of court.
semantic_expansions: 病房：一排床都在护士眼皮底下的那一间
受监护人：由别人看着、替他做主的那个人

words.root_logic: ward（wardon 看守）+ robe（衣物）→ 替人看着衣物的那个地方
words.origin: 古法语 warderobe（存衣处），是 garderobe 的诺曼变体：garder（看守）← 法兰克语 *wardon ＋ robe（衣物）
words.native_definition: a tall cupboard for clothes; all the clothes a person owns
words.core_concept: the place that keeps your clothes for you – 替你把衣物看着的那一处
words.core_image: 拉开那扇高门，里头一根横杆挂满衣架，底下还码着两只鞋盒
examples: Hang your coat in the wardrobe.
She bought a whole new wardrobe.
semantic_expansions: 衣柜：立着的那个存衣物的柜子
全部衣物：一个人存在里头的那一整套

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ nov（novus 新的）+ -ation → 把新东西弄进原来那一套里
words.origin: 拉丁语 innovatio ← innovare：in-（进入）＋ novare（使变新）← novus（新的）
words.native_definition: a new method or idea brought into use
words.core_concept: putting something never used before into the old way – 把从没用过的东西放进原来那套里
words.core_image: 车间里那道工序照老样子做了十年，有人改了一下，当天出来的件就不一样了
examples: The factory introduced several innovations.
Innovation drives the whole car industry.
semantic_expansions: 创新：想出并做出前所未有的做法
革新：把旧的那一套换成新的
新举措：被放进来的那个具体新做法

words.root_logic: novellus（novus 的指小形：新出的小东西）→ 新出的故事；也指从没见过的
words.origin: 古法语 novel（新的）与意大利语 novella（新故事）← 拉丁语 novellus，是 novus（新的）的指小形
words.native_definition: a long written story; not like anything seen before
words.core_concept: a fresh piece that has not been told or seen before – 新出的那一份，此前没被讲过、没被见过
words.core_image: 手里那本厚册子一口气翻到半夜；书里的写法从没见人这么用过
examples: She wrote her first novel at thirty.
That is a novel approach.
semantic_expansions: 小说：一册新讲出来的长故事
新奇的：此前没见过这一种

words.root_logic: novel（novus 新的）+ -ty → 新出这个性质；也指靠这股劲吸引人的小物件
words.origin: 古法语 novelte ← 晚期拉丁语 novellitas ← novellus（新出的）← novus（新的）
words.native_definition: the quality of being new and unusual; a small unusual object
words.core_concept: the freshness that only lasts while a thing is still new – 只在东西还新时存在的那股劲
words.core_image: 头两天人人围着看，到第七天它摆在那儿，谁也不多瞧一眼
examples: The novelty soon wore off.
They sell novelties at the fair.
semantic_expansions: 新奇：此前没见过这一种的那个性质
新鲜感：这股劲留在人心里的那一阵
小玩意：全靠这股劲卖出去的那种小东西

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ nov（novus 新的）+ -ate → 把旧的再弄成新的
words.origin: 拉丁语 renovare 的过去分词 renovatus：re-（再）＋ novare（使变新）← novus（新的）
words.native_definition: to repair an old building so that it looks new again
words.core_concept: making an old thing new a second time – 把旧的那件再一次做成新的
words.core_image: 屋顶掀了重铺，墙皮铲掉刷白，同一栋老房子看着像刚盖起来
examples: They renovated the old farmhouse.
The hotel was fully renovated.
semantic_expansions: 翻新：把旧东西整成像新的一样
修复：把坏掉的地方修回原样

words.root_logic: calc（calx 石灰石）+ -ium（元素名后缀）→ 从石灰里认出来的那种元素
words.origin: 近代拉丁语 calcium，1808 年戴维由拉丁语 calx（属格 calcis：石灰、石灰石）造出
words.native_definition: a soft grey metal found in bones, teeth and lime
words.core_concept: the stuff that lime and bones are both made of – 石灰与骨头里同一样的那种料
words.core_image: 喝完一碗白汤去照片子，骨头那几道白得发亮
examples: Milk contains a lot of calcium.
Calcium keeps growing bones strong.

words.root_logic: calcul（calculus：calx 的指小形，小石子）+ -ate → 摆石子记数 → 算出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 calculare 的过去分词 calculatus ← calculus（小石子），是 calx（石灰石）的指小形
words.native_definition: to work out an amount or number using numbers
words.core_concept: moving pebbles one by one until a number comes out – 一颗颗挪石子，最后挪出一个数
words.core_image: 他在纸边上竖着列了三行数，笔尖一路往下点，末尾圈住一个数
examples: She calculated the total cost.
We calculated the risk first.
semantic_expansions: 计算：按数一步步挪出结果
推算：由已知的往未知的那一步挪
估计：挪得不细，只求个大概数

words.root_logic: chalk（古英语 cealc，早期借自 calx 石灰）→ 能划出白痕的那种软白石
words.origin: 古英语 cealc（石灰、白垩），早期从拉丁语 calx（石灰）借入，与 calcium 同出一词
words.native_definition: a soft white rock, or a stick of it used for writing
words.core_concept: soft white stone that leaves its mark when dragged – 一划就在别处留下白痕的软白石
words.core_image: 一截白棍在黑板上划过，留下一道粉白的痕，指头一抹就花了
examples: He wrote the date in chalk.
The cliffs are made of chalk.
semantic_expansions: 粉笔：截成小棍、拿来写字的那一段
白垩：整片山体里那种软白的石

words.root_logic: fabrica（工坊、做出来的东西）→ 坊里织出来的那块料；也指整件的构造
words.origin: 古法语 fabrique ← 拉丁语 fabrica（工坊、制成物）← faber（匠人）
words.native_definition: cloth made by weaving; the basic structure of something
words.core_concept: threads worked into one whole piece – 一根根织到一处，成了整整一块
words.core_image: 摊开一块布，经线纬线一根压一根，捏起一角能看见光从缝里透过来
examples: She chose a soft cotton fabric.
Trust holds the fabric of society.
semantic_expansions: 织物/布料：织成整块的那种料
结构：把整件东西撑住的那套编法

words.root_logic: fabric（fabrica 工坊）+ -ate → 在坊里把零件做成整件；也用于凭空做出一件
words.origin: 拉丁语 fabricare 的过去分词 fabricatus ← fabrica（工坊）← faber（匠人）
words.native_definition: to make or assemble something; to invent something false
words.core_concept: putting pieces together into a thing that was not there – 把零件拼成一件原先不存在的东西
words.core_image: 台钳上夹着几片铁，敲弯、焊拢，出来一件原先没有的东西
examples: They fabricate parts for engines.
He fabricated the whole story.
semantic_expansions: 制造：把零件拼装成整件
编造：同样的手法用在一段没发生过的事上
伪造：照着真的做出一件假的

words.root_logic: forge（fabrica 经通俗拉丁语 *faurga → 打铁棚）→ 在炉上锤成形；锤出来的也可以是假的
words.origin: 古法语 forge ← 通俗拉丁语 *faurga ← 拉丁语 fabrica（工坊），故与 fabric 同出一词
words.native_definition: to shape metal by heating and hammering; to make a false copy
words.core_concept: beaten into shape at the fire – 在火边一锤一锤打出形状来
words.core_image: 炉膛里那块铁烧到发红，夹出来搁在砧上，锤一下溅一片火星
examples: The smith forged an iron hook.
He forged his father's signature.
semantic_expansions: 锻造：烧红了锤出形状
伪造：同样是自己锤出来的，只是照着真的做
锻炉：干这件事的那座炉

words.root_logic: de-（引开）+ lic（lacere 逗引）+ -ate → 被逗着娇养出来的 → 细致而经不起碰
words.origin: 拉丁语 delicatus（娇养的、讲究的），与 deliciae（乐事）同支；其更早词源不明
words.native_definition: finely made and easily damaged; needing careful handling
words.core_concept: made so fine that a heavy hand ruins it – 做得太细，手一重就毁了
words.core_image: 薄胎的杯子举到灯下能透光，指头稍一使劲就听见细响
examples: She wore a delicate silver chain.
This is a delicate matter.
semantic_expansions: 精致的：做得细，经得起细看
脆弱的：细到一碰就坏
微妙的：事情细到一动就变，得轻着来

words.root_logic: de-（引开）+ lic（lacere 逗引）+ -ious → 把人勾住的那种味道
words.origin: 古法语 delicieus ← 晚期拉丁语 deliciosus ← 拉丁语 deliciae（乐事）← delicere（引开、逗引）
words.native_definition: having a very pleasant taste or smell
words.core_concept: a taste that pulls you back for more – 那味道把人又勾回去一口
words.core_image: 第一口下去人停了半秒，筷子又伸回同一个盘子
examples: The soup was absolutely delicious.
A delicious smell filled the room.
semantic_expansions: 美味的：味道好到把人勾住
可口的：吃着顺口，还想再来

words.root_logic: de-（引开）+ light（原为 delectare 使愉悦，后拼写被 light 带偏）→ 被逗得心里一亮
words.origin: 古法语 delitier ← 拉丁语 delectare（使愉悦），是 delicere（逗引）的反复形；中古英语原作 delite，后受 light 影响改拼 -ght
words.native_definition: great pleasure, or to give someone great pleasure
words.core_concept: lit up inside by something good – 被好东西逗得里头一亮
words.core_image: 孩子把盒子打开怔了一下，随后蹦起来抱住送东西的人
examples: She read the letter with delight.
The show delighted the children.
semantic_expansions: 高兴：心里被逗亮的那个状态
乐事：让人这样亮起来的那件事
使高兴：把这份亮劲给到别人身上

words.root_logic: im-（往上加）+ puls（pellere 推）→ 从里头推来的那一下
words.origin: 拉丁语 impulsus（推动）← impellere：in-（往上、加上）＋ pellere（推）
words.native_definition: a sudden wish to do something; a push that starts movement
words.core_concept: one shove from inside, before thinking – 里头推来那一下，还没想就动了
words.core_image: 站在货架前本来没打算买，手忽然自己伸过去把它放进筐里
examples: He bought it on impulse.
The blow gave the ball impulse.
semantic_expansions: 冲动：里头推来那一下，人跟着就做了
一时兴起：那一下过去也就没了
推动力：让东西动起来的那一推

words.root_logic: puls（pulsus，pellere 推的过去分词）→ 一下一下推出来的那个跳
words.origin: 古法语 pouls ← 拉丁语 pulsus（推动、跳动），是 pellere（推）的过去分词
words.native_definition: the regular beat of blood as the heart pushes it round
words.core_concept: one push, then another, at even spacing – 推一下，隔一样长再推一下
words.core_image: 两指按在腕上不动，过一会儿指腹下面顶起来一下，隔一会儿又顶一下
examples: The nurse took his pulse.
A pulse of light crossed the screen.
semantic_expansions: 脉搏：血被一下下推着走时手上摸到的那一顶
搏动：任何这样隔着相同间隔的一跳一跳
脉冲：一小股推出去、很快收住的那一下

words.root_logic: push（← pulsare，pellere 的反复形：一再推）→ 手上加力把东西推开
words.origin: 古法语 poulser/pousser ← 拉丁语 pulsare（一再推击），是 pellere（推）的反复形
words.native_definition: to press against something to move it away from you
words.core_concept: force put on a thing to send it away from you – 加力在东西上，让它离手往外走
words.core_image: 两手抵在箱子侧面往前送，箱底在地上擦出一声，挪开了半尺
examples: He pushed the door open.
She pushed him to try again.
semantic_expansions: 推：加力让东西离手往外
推动：让一件事往前走
催逼：把这股力加在人身上

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ veni（venire 来）+ -ent → 各样条件都来到一处 → 省事
words.origin: 拉丁语 conveniens（相合的），是 convenire 的现在分词：com-（一起）＋ venire（来）
words.native_definition: easy to use or reach, and not causing trouble
words.core_concept: everything coming together so nothing costs extra effort – 各样条件凑到一处，不用多费事
words.core_image: 出门左手第二个门就是，买完还赶得上那班车
examples: The shop is very convenient for us.
Pick a convenient time to meet.
semantic_expansions: 方便的：条件凑齐了，办这件事不费劲
便利的：地方或东西本身就近手
合适的：时间与安排也刚好凑上

words.root_logic: e-（出来）+ vent（venire 来）→ 来了、出来了 → 发生的那件事
words.origin: 拉丁语 eventus（结果、发生的事）← evenire：ex-（出来）＋ venire（来）
words.native_definition: something that happens, especially something important
words.core_concept: a thing that has come out and taken place – 已经来出来、落地发生了的那一件
words.core_image: 日历上那一格圈着红圈，那天街上搭起棚子，人从早上就往那儿走
examples: The wedding was a happy event.
He won three events at the meeting.
semantic_expansions: 事件：发生了的那一件事
大事：发生得够分量、被记住的那件
项目：赛程里单独发生的那一场

words.root_logic: e-（出来）+ vent（venire 来）+ -ual + -ly → 到底还是来出来了 → 最后
words.origin: 近代拉丁语 eventualis ← 拉丁语 eventus（结果）← evenire：ex-（出来）＋ venire（来）
words.native_definition: in the end, after a long time or much trouble
words.core_concept: coming out at last, after everything in between – 中间那些都过去了，它到底出来了
words.core_image: 队排了两个钟头，前面的人一个个挪走，轮到他时天都黑了
examples: He eventually agreed to help.
The delayed train eventually arrived.
semantic_expansions: 最终：一路到最后才出来的那个结果
终于：等了许久之后它出来了

words.root_logic: prais（pretium 价值）→ 把人做的事估出高价，并说出口
words.origin: 古法语 preisier ← 晚期拉丁语 pretiare（定价、看重）← 拉丁语 pretium（价格、价值）；与 precari（祈求）无关
words.native_definition: to say that someone or something is very good
words.core_concept: putting a high value on it out loud – 把它估得很高，并且说出来
words.core_image: 他把作业收上去翻了两页，抬头当着全班念了那一段
examples: The teacher praised her hard work.
His book won high praise.
semantic_expansions: 赞扬：当面把它估得高
称赞：说出它好在哪一处
表扬：在众人面前把这个估价讲一遍

words.root_logic: priz（pretium 价值）→ 值这个价的那样东西 → 奖品；动词是把它看得值
words.origin: 古法语 pris（价值、奖赏）← 拉丁语 pretium（价格、价值）
words.native_definition: something given to the winner; to value something highly
words.core_concept: the thing judged worth having – 被判为值得的那一样
words.core_image: 台上那只银杯谁赢了就端走，捧着的人手一直没松
examples: She won first prize in the race.
He prizes his grandfather's watch.
semantic_expansions: 奖品：赢的人拿走的那件值钱东西
珍视：自己心里把它估得很高，舍不得

words.root_logic: common（communis 共有的）+ wealth（福祉）→ 大家共有的那份好处 → 结成一体的国家
words.origin: 中古英语 commonwelth：common（← 拉丁语 communis 共有的）＋ wealth（福祉、财富）
words.native_definition: a group of countries or states joined for shared purposes
words.core_concept: the good that a group holds together – 一群人合在一处共有的那份好处
words.core_image: 几个岛各挂着自己的旗，每年派人坐到同一张长桌前把账目摊开
examples: Australia belongs to the Commonwealth.
The commonwealth funded the road.
semantic_expansions: 联邦：为共有的那份好处结成一体的一群国家
共同体：同样合在一处、利害相通的那一群
全体国民：这份好处所归属的所有人

words.root_logic: punch（punctionem ← pungere 刺）→ 一下猛戳出去 → 出拳；也指戳孔的那件工具
words.origin: 中古英语 punchen ← 古法语 poinçonner ← 通俗拉丁语 punctiare ← 拉丁语 pungere（刺）；饮料那义另出印地语 pāñč（五）
words.native_definition: to hit with a closed hand; a tool for making holes
words.core_concept: the whole force gathered onto one small spot – 一股力全收到一个小点上顶进去
words.core_image: 他攥紧手往前送出去，正撞在沙袋中间，袋子晃了一下
examples: He punched the bag hard.
Punch two holes in the card.
semantic_expansions: 用拳打：把力收在拳头这一点上送出去
一拳：这样送出去的那一下
冲孔器：靠同一手法在纸或皮上顶出小孔的工具

words.origin: 古法语 miracle ← 拉丁语 miraculum（奇事）← mirari（惊奇）← mirus（奇妙）
words.native_definition: something wonderful that happens although it seems impossible
words.core_concept: a thing that happened though it should not have – 照理不该发生，却真发生了的那一件
words.core_image: 车翻进沟里烂成一堆，人从驾驶座爬出来，身上连道口子都没有
examples: It was a miracle that he survived.
She is hoping for a miracle.
semantic_expansions: 奇迹：办不到的事偏偏成了
奇事：让人说不出所以然的那一件
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 mirour ← 通俗拉丁语 *miratorium ← 拉丁语 mirari（惊奇、看）← mirus（奇妙）
words.native_definition: a piece of glass that shows what is in front of it
words.core_concept: a surface that gives back what stands before it – 一个面把跟前的东西原样还回来
words.core_image: 他抬头看见一张和自己一模一样的脸，抬手时那张脸也抬了手
examples: She looked at herself in the mirror.
His words mirror our own doubts.
semantic_expansions: 镜子：把跟前的样子原样还回来的那块面
反映：一件事把另一件的样子照出来
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 诺曼法语 gaiole ← 中世纪拉丁语 gabiola ← 晚期拉丁语 caveola（小笼），是 cavea（围栏、笼）的指小形；与 jail 同出一词，只是拼写走了两路
words.native_definition: a place where people are locked up as punishment
words.core_concept: a locked cage built for people – 给人造的那种上了锁的笼
words.core_image: 铁条门在身后合上，走廊两侧一格一格，钥匙串的声音越走越远
examples: He spent two years in gaol.
The old gaol is now a museum.
semantic_expansions: 监狱：整座锁着人的那处地方
牢房：里头一格一格关人的那一间
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: com-（一并）+ prehend（prehendere 抓）→ 把整件事一把抓全
words.origin: 拉丁语 comprehendere：com-（一并）+ prehendere（抓住）——把一件事的各处一并抓住
words.native_definition: to grasp the meaning of something fully
words.core_concept: to grasp a thing whole in the mind – 把整件事一把抓全
words.core_image: 讲到第三遍时，那些散着的说法忽然连成一条线，心里一下子亮了
examples: I cannot comprehend why she left so suddenly.
Young children rarely comprehend such abstract rules.
semantic_expansions: 抓住了整件事的形状是「理解」；抓得轻些、只抓住话里的意思是「领会」

words.root_logic: com-（一并）+ pris（prehendere 抓）→ 一把抓进来的那些就是它的全部
words.origin: 古法语 compris（comprendre 的过去分词）← 拉丁语 comprehendere：com-（一并）+ prehendere（抓住）
words.native_definition: to consist of the parts named
words.core_concept: to take all the parts in together – 把各部分一并揽进来
words.core_image: 一只手把五六样零件全揽住，摊开给人看，就这些，不多不少
examples: The committee comprises twelve members from six countries.
Water comprises hydrogen and oxygen.
semantic_expansions: 揽住的那些都算在内是「包含」；从整体一侧看这同一件事是「由...组成」；从部件一侧看是「构成」

words.root_logic: entre-（伸到当中）+ pris（prehendere 抓）→ 伸手把一件难事抓下来
words.origin: 古法语 entreprise（entreprendre 的过去分词）：entre-（在当中）+ prendre（拿、抓）← 拉丁语 prehendere
words.native_definition: a bold undertaking, or a business set up to carry one out
words.core_concept: reaching in and taking on a hard job – 伸手把难事接下来
words.core_image: 三个人凑齐钱租下一间空铺面，卷帘门一拉开就算开张
examples: The family runs a small printing enterprise.
Building a canal here took real enterprise.
semantic_expansions: 接下这摊事的那个组织是「企业」；这摊事本身是「事业」；敢伸手去接的那股劲是「进取心」

words.root_logic: praeda（抓到手的那一份）与 prehendere 同一个「抓」→ 被抓住的那一方
words.origin: 古法语 preie ← 拉丁语 praeda（猎获物），由 prae-（在前）加与 prehendere 同源的「抓」构成
words.native_definition: an animal hunted and taken by another, or to hunt in this way
words.core_concept: the one that gets seized – 被抓住的那一方
words.core_image: 草丛里那只兔子刚抬头，颈上已经落了一口牙
examples: The owl swooped down on its prey.
Wild dogs prey on weak calves.
semantic_expansions: 被抓住的那只活物是「猎物」；动词说去抓这一动作是「捕食」；把这幅画面挪到人身上，被人算计的那个是「受害者」

words.root_logic: pris（prehendere 抓）+ -on → 人被抓住之后关进去的那个地方
words.origin: 古法语 prisoun ← 拉丁语 prehensio（抓捕，属格 prehensionis）← prehendere（抓住）
words.native_definition: a building where people are locked up as punishment
words.core_concept: the place the seized are kept – 抓来的人关着的地方
words.core_image: 铁门在身后合上，走廊尽头一扇小窗，天只剩巴掌大一块
examples: He spent four years in prison for fraud.
The old prison was torn down last spring.
semantic_expansions: 整座关人的建筑是「监狱」；里头单间那一格是「牢房」

words.root_logic: pris（prehendere 抓）+ -oner（那个人）→ 被抓住关起来的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 prisonier ← prisoun（抓捕、关押处）← 拉丁语 prehensio ← prehendere（抓住）
words.native_definition: a person kept locked up, in jail or by an enemy
words.core_concept: the person held after being seized – 被抓住关着的那个人
words.core_image: 两手背在身后铐着，被人押过一条长廊，连鞋带都抽走了
examples: The prisoner was led back to his cell.
Enemy soldiers took twelve prisoners that night.
semantic_expansions: 由法办关进去的是「囚犯」；在战场上被对方抓住的是「俘虏」

words.root_logic: sur-（从上头）+ pris（prehendere 抓）→ 从头顶上一把抓住，来不及防
words.origin: 古法语 surprise（surprendre 的过去分词）：sur-（在上、突然）+ prendre（抓）← 拉丁语 prehendere
words.native_definition: to catch someone unawares, or the feeling this causes
words.core_concept: seized from above before one can guard – 从上头一把抓住，防不及
words.core_image: 推开门，黑着的屋里忽然齐声一喊，手里的钥匙掉在地上
examples: Her question took me completely by surprise.
We surprised him with a cake.
semantic_expansions: 被这么一抓时心里那一下是「惊讶」；动词是去制造这一下，即「使惊讶」；军事上从对方没防的一侧扑上去是「突袭」

words.root_logic: col-（一同）+ leg（lex 一支的「依法委派」）→ 依同一道任命派在一处的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 collega（同任一职的人）：com-（一同）+ leg-（lex 一支表「依法委派」）
words.native_definition: someone you work with, especially in a profession
words.core_concept: one posted to the same office by the same law – 同一道任命派在一处的人
words.core_image: 隔一张桌子的那个人，开会坐一排，中午常一块下楼吃饭
examples: I asked a colleague to cover my class.
Her colleagues gave her a farewell card.
semantic_expansions: 日常说共事的人是「同事」；用在官署里同级共事的是「同僚」

words.root_logic: legis（lex 的属格：法条）+ lation（搬来、提出）→ 把法条搬上台面立起来
words.origin: 拉丁语 legislatio：lex 的属格 legis（法条）+ latio（搬来、提出）
words.native_definition: laws as a body, or the act of making them
words.core_concept: bringing statutes forward and setting them up – 把法条提上来立住
words.core_image: 议场里举手表决完，一叠条文盖上章，从此照着它办
examples: New legislation on data will take effect soon.
Parliament passed the legislation last month.
semantic_expansions: 制定法条这件事是「立法」；立出来的那一批条文是「法规」

words.root_logic: legi（lex 法条）+ -timus（合于……的）→ 拿法条一量，量得过去
words.origin: 拉丁语 legitimus（合法条的）← lex（属格 legis：法条）
words.native_definition: allowed by law or by accepted standards
words.core_concept: standing up when measured against the statute – 拿法条一量站得住
words.core_image: 柜台后的人把证件翻到最后一页，抬头点了下头，章盖下去
examples: She is the legitimate owner of the land.
That seems a legitimate reason to complain.
semantic_expansions: 严格照条文讲得通是「合法的」；放宽到情理上站得住是「正当的」；再放宽到讲得出道理是「合理的」

words.root_logic: loial ← legalis（照法条的）← lex（法条）→ 守着当初那道约不改口
words.origin: 古法语 loial / leial ← 拉丁语 legalis（照法条的）← lex（属格 legis：法条）
words.native_definition: staying firm in support of a person or cause
words.core_concept: holding to the bond as if bound by law – 守着那道约不松口
words.core_image: 换了三任领班，那条狗还每天守在原来那道门口等
examples: He stayed loyal to the team for years.
Loyal readers kept the small paper alive.
semantic_expansions: 说人不背弃是「忠诚的」；说态度一贯不变是「忠实的」

words.root_logic: loyal（照法条守约的）+ -ty（那种性质）→ 守约不改口这件事本身
words.origin: 古法语 loialte ← loial ← 拉丁语 legalis（照法条的）← lex（属格 legis：法条）
words.native_definition: firm and steady support for someone or something
words.core_concept: the habit of holding to one's bond – 守约不改口的那份性情
words.core_image: 老店关门那天，几个熟客一早就来站在檐下，站到卷帘门落下
examples: Her loyalty to old friends never wavered.
The company rewards loyalty with longer holidays.
semantic_expansions: 说不背弃这件事整体是「忠诚」；偏说心里那份不移的是「忠心」

words.root_logic: privi（私人的）+ lege（lex 法条）→ 单为一个人写的那道法条
words.origin: 拉丁语 privilegium：privus（私人的）+ lex（属格 legis：法条）——专为某一个人立的条文
words.native_definition: a special right given to one person or group
words.core_concept: a statute written for one alone – 单为一人写的条文
words.core_image: 长队排到门口，他掏出一张卡，侧门直接开了，队里的人都看着
examples: Club members enjoy the privilege of free parking.
It was a privilege to work here.
semantic_expansions: 只归少数人的那份权是「特权」；落到日常照顾上是「优待」；轮到自己头上时客气着说是「荣幸」

words.root_logic: modus（量度、限度、办法）→ 定下的那一套做法，照它走就不出界
words.origin: 拉丁语 modus（量度、限度、办法）
words.native_definition: a particular way in which something is done or works
words.core_concept: the set way a thing is done – 定下的那一套做法
words.core_image: 相机上的转盘拨到某一格，快门和光圈就都按那一格的规矩走
examples: Trains are the cheapest mode of travel here.
Switch the phone to silent mode.
semantic_expansions: 单说做一件事走哪条路是「方式」；这套做法固定成型、可反复照办时是「模式」

words.root_logic: modulus（modus 的小尺度）→ 按小一号尺寸做出来的那个样子，照它做大的
words.origin: 意大利语 modello ← 通俗拉丁语 modellus ← 拉丁语 modulus（小尺度）← modus（量度）
words.native_definition: a small copy or a pattern that others are made from
words.core_concept: a scaled pattern others follow – 按尺寸做出的样子，照它做
words.core_image: 桌上一座巴掌大的楼，窗户楼梯都齐，工地照着它砌
examples: He built a model of the bridge.
She models for a local design school.
semantic_expansions: 按尺寸缩小做出的实物是「模型」；拿人当样子照着学是「模范」；给衣裳当样子给人看的人是「模特」；动词把一件事照样子搭出来是「建模」

words.root_logic: modestus（守着分寸的）← modus（量度、限度）→ 不越过那条线
words.origin: 拉丁语 modestus（守分寸的）← modus（量度、限度）
words.native_definition: not boasting, or not large in amount
words.core_concept: keeping inside the line, not over – 守着那条线不越过
words.core_image: 全场鼓掌时他摆摆手，只说这活儿是好几个人一起干的
examples: He is modest about his own success.
They live on a modest income.
semantic_expansions: 说人不把功劳往自己身上堆是「谦虚的」；说数量不出格是「适度的」；说排场不铺张是「朴素的」

words.root_logic: modulus（modus 的小尺度）→ 按统一尺寸做的一小块，块块能对上、能换
words.origin: 拉丁语 modulus（小尺度、小单位）← modus（量度）
words.native_definition: one standard part of a larger system, able to be swapped
words.core_concept: one standard-sized part of a whole – 照统一尺寸做的一块
words.core_image: 机柜里抽出一块板子，换上另一块，尺寸和接口都对得上
examples: Each module can be replaced in minutes.
The course has six modules this term.
semantic_expansions: 拆得下装得上的那一块是「模块」；强调它是整机的一部分时说「组件」；课程里自成一段的是「单元」

words.root_logic: modulus（modus 的小尺度、样式）→ 一个空壳，浆倒进去凝住就成它的样子
words.origin: 古法语 modle ← 拉丁语 modulus（小尺度、样式）← modus（量度）
words.native_definition: a hollow shape that liquid is poured into to set
words.core_concept: the hollow that gives a thing its shape – 决定成品形状的那个空壳
words.core_image: 铁壳里灌进滚烫的浆，等凉透了扣出来，边角和壳里一模一样
examples: Pour the mixture into a round mould.
Hard years moulded his character.
semantic_expansions: 日常那个成形的壳是「模子」；用在金属浇铸上是「铸模」；动词把人或事按某个样子做出来是「塑造」

words.root_logic: centum（一百）→ 一块钱切成一百份，其中的一份
words.origin: 法语 cent ← 拉丁语 centum（一百）
words.native_definition: a coin worth one hundredth of a dollar or euro
words.core_concept: one part in a hundred of the money – 钱的百分之一那一份
words.core_image: 罐子里倒出一把铜的小圆片，数出一百个刚够换一张纸币
examples: The apples cost ninety cents a pound.
He paid the last cent he had.
semantic_expansions: 作货币单位是「分」；指那枚铜片实物是「一分硬币」

words.root_logic: centum（一百）+ gradus（一级、一步）→ 把冰点到沸点之间切成一百级
words.origin: 拉丁语 centum（一百）+ gradus（级、度）——定标时把水的冰点到沸点分成一百等份
words.native_definition: measured on a scale with one hundred steps between freezing and boiling
words.core_concept: a scale cut into a hundred steps – 切成一百级的那把标尺
words.core_image: 温度计上从结冰那道线到冒泡那道线，中间正好切成一百格
examples: Water boils at one hundred degrees centigrade.
Set the oven to two hundred degrees centigrade.
semantic_expansions: 日常说温标是「摄氏的」；照字面讲这套刻度是「百分度的」

words.root_logic: centuria（百人一队）← centum（一百）→ 数满一百的那一段，用在年上
words.origin: 拉丁语 centuria（百人编成的一队、百的一组）← centum（一百）
words.native_definition: a period of one hundred years
words.core_concept: a hundred counted off as one span – 数满一百作一整段
words.core_image: 教堂墙上刻的年份比曾祖父的曾祖父还早，中间隔了几辈都数不清
examples: The church was built four centuries ago.
She lived through most of the century.
semantic_expansions: 划成整段的那一百年是「世纪」；单说这段时长是「百年」

words.root_logic: per（每）+ centum（一百）→ 每一百里占几
words.origin: 拉丁语 per centum（每一百）
words.native_definition: one part in every hundred
words.core_concept: so many in every hundred – 每一百里占的那几份
words.core_image: 一百格的方阵涂黑了十七格，一眼看得出占多大一片
examples: Only three percent of seeds ever sprouted.
Prices rose by ten percent last year.
semantic_expansions: 作单位说每百里的一份是「百分之一」；说占比这件事整体是「百分比」

words.root_logic: intrare（走进去）← intra（在里面）→ 从外头跨进里头
words.origin: 古法语 entrer ← 拉丁语 intrare（走进去）← intra（在里面）
words.native_definition: to come or go into a place
words.core_concept: crossing in from outside – 从外头跨进里头
words.core_image: 玻璃门被推开，风被关在身后，鞋底在地垫上蹭了两下
examples: She entered the room without knocking.
Enter your name in the first box.
semantic_expansions: 跨进一处地方是「进入」；跨进一群人里是「加入」；把字跨进格子里是「输入」

words.root_logic: entr（intrare 走进去）+ -ance（那处、那件事）→ 进去用的那个口，也指进去这一下
words.origin: 古法语 entrance ← entrer（进去）← 拉丁语 intrare（走进去）
words.native_definition: the way into a place, or the act of going in
words.core_concept: the way in, and the going in – 进去的那个口和那一下
words.core_image: 台阶尽头一道拱门，人流从那里挤进去，两边墙上挂着牌子
examples: Wait for me at the main entrance.
His entrance stopped the conversation.
semantic_expansions: 那道口子是「入口」；那一下动作是「进入」；正式场合走进来这件事是「入场」

words.root_logic: entr（intrare 走进去）+ -y → 进去这一下，也指进去后落下的那一条记录
words.origin: 古法语 entree（进入）← entrer ← 拉丁语 intrare（走进去）
words.native_definition: the act of going in, or an item written into a list
words.core_concept: going in, and what the going in leaves written – 进去这一下和留下的那一行
words.core_image: 门房把名字一笔写进本子，那一行落定，人才放进去
examples: No entry without a ticket.
Check the last entry in the log.
semantic_expansions: 那一下动作是「进入」；写进册子里的一行是「条目」；供人进去的那道口子也叫「入口」

words.root_logic: regula（笔直的木尺、准绳）→ 一根直挺挺的长条，横着架起来
words.origin: 古法语 reille（横木、栏条）← 拉丁语 regula（笔直的木尺）
words.native_definition: a long bar of wood or metal fixed in place
words.core_concept: a straight bar fixed in place – 一根架起来的直条
words.core_image: 两条铁条笔直铺出去，枕木一根根压着，远处并成一条线
examples: Do not lean over the rail.
Freight moves by rail across the country.
semantic_expansions: 火车压着走的那两条是「铁轨」；拦在人前的那道横条是「栏杆」；整套轨道连成的运输是「铁路」

words.root_logic: rail（regula 直条，即铁轨）+ road（路）→ 用直条铺出来的那条路
words.origin: 英语 rail（铁轨，← 拉丁语 regula 笔直的木尺）+ road（路）
words.native_definition: a track of rails, and the system of trains running on it
words.core_concept: a road made of straight bars – 直条铺成的路
words.core_image: 两条铁条一路铺到看不见的地方，中间的碎石被压得发亮
examples: The railroad reached this town in 1889.
He worked on the railroad for decades.
semantic_expansions: 连着线路和运营整体说是「铁路」；单指那条轨道设施是「铁道」

words.root_logic: regula（笔直的木尺、准绳）→ 立一根直的当准，众人照它比齐
words.origin: 古法语 reule ← 拉丁语 regula（笔直的木尺、准绳）
words.native_definition: a statement of what may be done, or to govern
words.core_concept: the straight standard all are lined up to – 众人照着比齐的那根准绳
words.core_image: 墙上贴着一张纸，谁做完都要拿它对一遍，对不上就重做
examples: The rules of the game are simple.
That family ruled the island for centuries.
semantic_expansions: 立出来叫大家照办的是「规则」；握着这根准绳管人是「统治」；拿它量一件事并给出结论是「裁定」

words.root_logic: rule（regula 准绳）+ -er（那样东西、那个人）→ 那根尺本身，或手里握着准绳的那个
words.origin: 英语 rule（← 拉丁语 regula 笔直的木尺）+ -er
words.native_definition: a strip used for drawing straight lines, or a person who governs
words.core_concept: the one holding the straight standard – 握着那根准绳的
words.core_image: 透明的塑料条压在纸上，铅笔顺着边走，线才不歪
examples: Draw the line with a ruler.
The ruler ordered a new palace built.
semantic_expansions: 那根实物直条是「尺子」；握着准绳定规矩的人是「统治者」

words.root_logic: con-（彻底）+ fess（fari 一支的 fateri：承认）→ 把压着不说的那句彻底说出口
words.origin: 拉丁语 confiteri（承认）的过去分词 confessus：con-（彻底）+ -fiteri ← fari（说、开口）
words.native_definition: to admit something you were hiding
words.core_concept: speaking out what was held back – 把压着的那句说出口
words.core_image: 在桌子对面坐了半个钟头不出声，忽然抬起头把那件事讲了
examples: He confessed that he had lied.
She finally confessed to taking the money.
semantic_expansions: 只说认下来是「承认」；把过程都讲出来是「坦白」；向神职人员说自己的过失是「忏悔」

words.root_logic: fama（众人传的话）← fari（开口说）→ 众人嘴里都在说的那一份
words.origin: 拉丁语 fama（传闻、名声）← fari（说、开口）
words.native_definition: the state of being known and talked about by many
words.core_concept: what everyone's mouths carry about you – 众人嘴里传着的那一份
words.core_image: 街上走十步被叫住三回，卖水果的都知道他昨天干了什么
examples: The song brought him sudden fame.
She never wanted fame or money.
semantic_expansions: 传开的话本身是「名声」；传得久、传得受敬重是「名望」

words.root_logic: fama（众人传的话）+ -ous（多有的）← fari（开口说）→ 被人说得多的
words.origin: 拉丁语 famosus（多被谈论的）← fama（传闻、名声）← fari（说、开口）
words.native_definition: known about by very many people
words.core_concept: much talked about – 被很多人说着的
words.core_image: 他一进门，屋里说话声低了一截，几个人抬起手机对着他
examples: This town is famous for its cheese.
A famous painter once lived here.
semantic_expansions: 正式说受人公认的是「著名的」；口语说人尽皆知的是「出名的」

words.root_logic: di-（分开各向）+ mens（metiri 量）+ -ion → 一个方向上量出来的那个数
words.origin: 拉丁语 dimensio（量出的尺寸）← dimetiri：di-（分开）+ metiri（量）
words.native_definition: a measurement in one direction, or an aspect of something
words.core_concept: how much a thing measures in one direction – 一个方向上量得的数
words.core_image: 拿卷尺量一只箱子，长、宽、高各记一个数，才说得清它多大
examples: Measure the dimensions of the room first.
This adds a new dimension to the case.
semantic_expansions: 量出的具体数目是「尺寸」；把方向本身当一条轴说是「维度」；挪到抽象事情上，一个可以量的侧面是「方面」

words.root_logic: im-（不）+ mens（metiri 的过去分词 mensus，量过的）→ 量不出来的那么大
words.origin: 拉丁语 immensus（量不出的）：in-（不）+ mensus（metiri 的过去分词，量过的）
words.native_definition: extremely large in size or degree
words.core_concept: too big for any measure to reach – 尺子量不到头
words.core_image: 站在沙丘上转一圈，沙子一直铺到天边，找不着一处头
examples: The desert stretched an immense distance.
She took immense care with it.
semantic_expansions: 说体量大到量不过来是「巨大的」；挪到程度上说是「极大的」

words.root_logic: mensura（量出来的尺寸）← metiri（量）→ 拿尺贴上去，读出它有多少
words.origin: 古法语 mesure ← 拉丁语 mensura（尺寸）← metiri（量）的过去分词 mensus
words.native_definition: to find the size of something, or a step taken to deal with something
words.core_concept: laying a standard against a thing – 拿尺贴上去读数
words.core_image: 卷尺贴着墙拉开，指甲掐住那一格，低头念出上面的数
examples: Measure the width before you cut.
The government took strong measures.
semantic_expansions: 动词拿尺去量是「测量」；量出的结果是「尺寸」；引申到办事上，为对付一件事拿出的那一份分量是「措施」

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ ped（pes 脚）+ -ition → 把脚从绊住的东西里解出来，一队人这才走得成
words.origin: 拉丁语 expeditio（出征）← expedire：ex-（出）+ pes（属格 pedis：脚）——把脚从绊索里解出来
words.native_definition: an organized journey made for a purpose
words.core_concept: feet set free so a party can set out – 脚解开了，一队人走得成
words.core_image: 天没亮，一队人背上包在门口清点绳子和帐篷，然后一个跟一个走进雪里
examples: The expedition reached the pole in March.
They joined a small fossil expedition.
semantic_expansions: 军事上出去打的是「远征」；一队人为查看而去的是「探险队」；规模小些、走着去的是「远足」

words.root_logic: pedalis（脚上的）← pes（脚）→ 用脚踩的那一块
words.origin: 拉丁语 pedalis（脚的、一尺长的）← pes（属格 pedis：脚）
words.native_definition: a lever pressed with the foot to work a machine
words.core_concept: the part worked by the foot – 用脚踩的那一块
words.core_image: 鞋底压下去，那块铁往下一沉，链条跟着咬住齿轮转起来
examples: He pressed the brake pedal hard.
She pedalled slowly up the hill.
semantic_expansions: 那块实物是「踏板」；动词一脚一脚踩它是「踩踏板」

words.root_logic: pedester（步行的）← pes（脚）→ 靠脚走的那个人，也指平平无奇像走路一样
words.origin: 拉丁语 pedester / pedestris（步行的）← pes（属格 pedis：脚）
words.native_definition: a person travelling on foot, or dull and ordinary
words.core_concept: going on one's own feet – 靠自己两只脚走的
words.core_image: 车让在斑马线前，一个人拎着袋子低头走过去，鞋底蹭着白漆
examples: A pedestrian was hit at the crossing.
His speech was flat and pedestrian.
semantic_expansions: 走路的那个人是「行人」；说不靠车马只靠脚的是「步行的」；走路比骑马低一等，引申到文章说话上是「平庸的」

words.root_logic: e-（出去）+ mit（mittere 送）→ 把光、声、气送出去
words.origin: 拉丁语 emittere：ex-（出）+ mittere（送、发出）
words.native_definition: to send out light, sound, gas, or the like
words.core_concept: sending a thing out from inside – 从里头把东西送出去
words.core_image: 管口噗地冒出一股白气，边上的灯一亮一灭，嗡嗡响着
examples: The lamp emits a faint blue light.
Factories emit smoke all day.
semantic_expansions: 光和声这类送出来是「发出」；气味热气慢慢往外走是「散发」；把废气废水放出去是「排放」

words.origin: 拉丁语 vallum（营垒的木栅）加表「之间」的前缀构成，本义两道栅墙当中空着的那段
words.native_definition: a space of time or distance between two things
words.core_concept: the gap left between two things – 两样东西之间空着的那段
words.core_image: 两班车之间空着的二十分钟，站台上只剩风和一张飘着的纸
examples: Buses run at ten minute intervals.
There was a long interval between acts.
semantic_expansions: 说两次之间隔多久多远是「间隔」；说中间那段停下不动的是「间歇」；戏剧里两幕之间那段是「幕间休息」
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 拉丁语 acidus（酸的）← acere（发酸）← acer（尖、锐）——舌头上像被尖东西扎一下
words.native_definition: a sour substance that can eat into metal or stone
words.core_concept: something sharp enough to bite – 尖得能咬进东西里
words.core_image: 一滴透亮的水落在铁片上，冒出细泡，铁面留下一小块麻点
examples: The acid burned a hole in the cloth.
She made an acid remark about it.
semantic_expansions: 那种能腐蚀的东西是「酸」；说味道扎舌头是「酸的」；说话像针一样扎人是「尖刻的」
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 aigre（尖、酸、猛）← 拉丁语 acer（尖、锐）——劲头尖得往前冲
words.native_definition: wanting to do something very much
words.core_concept: pointed forward, sharp with wanting – 劲头尖着往前顶
words.core_image: 话还没说完他已经站起来，手按在门把上，身子朝外倾着
examples: The children were eager to start.
He gave an eager nod.
semantic_expansions: 心里想要得厉害是「渴望的」；表现在神情动作上是「热切的」
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 cōc（厨子）← 拉丁语 coquus（厨子）← coquere（煮）——早期借入的日常词
words.native_definition: to prepare food with heat, or a person who does this
words.core_concept: putting food to the fire – 把吃的搁到火上
words.core_image: 锅里的油响起来，葱一下去满屋是味，铲子贴着锅底翻了两下
examples: She cooked rice and beans for us.
The cook came out to take orders.
semantic_expansions: 动词说这门手艺整体是「烹饪」；日常说给家里备饭是「做饭」；干这活儿的人是「厨师」
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 cycene ← 通俗拉丁语 cocina（拉丁语 coquina，煮东西的地方）← coquere（煮）
words.native_definition: the room where food is prepared
words.core_concept: the room given to cooking – 专管煮东西的那一间
words.core_image: 靠窗一张台面，刀和砧板挨着水槽，抽油烟机上一层薄油
examples: The kitchen smelled of garlic and smoke.
They sat talking in the kitchen.
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 mes（端上桌的一道菜）← 晚期拉丁语 missum（端上来的东西）；由「一盘混着的吃食」引申出杂乱一义
words.native_definition: a state of disorder, or to make something dirty and untidy
words.core_concept: a jumbled heap left lying about – 掺在一处堆着的一摊
words.core_image: 桌上摊着吃剩的盘子、拆开的包装和半杯凉茶，找钥匙得先挪三样东西
examples: The kitchen was in a terrible mess.
Do not mess up my papers.
semantic_expansions: 说秩序全乱是「混乱」；说又脏又乱是「脏乱」；动词把本来好的一件事搞坏是「弄糟」
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 ariver（靠岸、到达）← 通俗拉丁语 arripare：ad-（到）+ ripa（河岸）——船靠上岸
words.native_definition: the act of reaching a place, or someone who has just come
words.core_concept: coming up to the shore at last – 终于靠上岸
words.core_image: 站台上的人一齐朝那头看，车门开了，第一个人拎着箱子踏下来
examples: We waited for the arrival of the train.
The new arrival cried all night.
semantic_expansions: 到了这件事是「到达」；正式些说是「抵达」；刚到的那个人是「新来的人」
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 riviere（河、河岸地）← 通俗拉丁语 riparia（河岸一带）← 拉丁语 ripa（河岸）
words.native_definition: a large natural stream of water flowing to the sea
words.core_concept: water held between two banks – 两岸夹着的那道水
words.core_image: 两道土坡夹着一条浑水，一直流到看不见的地方，岸边泡着半截树根
examples: The river runs through three towns.
They swam across the river at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 单说一条水道是「河」；泛指大小水道整体时说「江河」
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 pantaisier（喘不上气）← 通俗拉丁语 pantasiare（梦里憋闷挣气）；再往上与希腊语「使显现」一支有关，但这一义已接不上
words.native_definition: to breathe in quick short breaths after effort
words.core_concept: breathing in fast shallow snatches – 一口接一口地急着吸气
words.core_image: 跑上六楼扶着墙，肩膀一起一伏，喉咙里像有风箱在拉
examples: He panted after running up the stairs.
The dog panted in the heat.
semantic_expansions: 动作本身是「喘气」；连着说这种状态是「气喘」
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 roial ← 拉丁语 regalis（王的）← rex（属格 regis：国王）
words.native_definition: belonging to or fit for a king or queen
words.core_concept: belonging to the king – 归国王的
words.core_image: 门口两个卫兵纹丝不动，车上一枚金色徽记，红毯一直铺到台阶顶
examples: The royal family arrived by carriage.
They gave him a royal welcome.
semantic_expansions: 指王的家族是「王室的」；用在挂王室名义的机构上是「皇家的」；借那份气派形容排场是「盛大的」
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: rect（regere 导正、理直）→ 古法语 dresser（把东西摆正、整理停当）→ 把身上的布料理齐 → 穿戴；理齐后的那一整件
words.origin: 古法语 dresser（排列整齐、装备好）← 通俗拉丁语 *directiare ← 拉丁语 directus（理直的），出自 regere（导正）
words.native_definition: to put clothes on, or a one-piece outer garment for a woman
words.core_concept: put in order on the body – 把身上收拾停当
words.core_image: 站在镜前把袖口捋平，领子翻正，腰上那道褶子一点点抹开
examples: She wore a blue dress to the ceremony.
He dressed quickly and left the house.
semantic_expansions: 把布料在身上理齐 → 穿衣这个动作
理齐后穿在身上的那一整件 → 连衣裙
不只理齐还添修饰 → 装扮、打扮

words.root_logic: rect（regere 统摄、导正）→ 拉丁语 regalis（王的）→ 古法语 reaume → 一个王发号令管得到的那片地；引申为某人说得上话的那一片
words.origin: 古法语 reaume/realme ← 通俗拉丁语 *regalimen ← 拉丁语 regalis（王的），出自 rex（王），与 regere（统摄）同一词干
words.native_definition: a kingdom, or an area of activity or interest
words.core_concept: the ground one ruler covers – 一位君主管得到的那一片
words.core_image: 地图上一圈墨线围出的地界，线内的赋税都送到同一座城里
examples: The story is set in a distant realm.
That question lies outside the realm of physics.
semantic_expansions: 一个王号令所及的那片地 → 王国
把「所及」抽掉具体的地 → 某学科或事务的领域
再抽一层，只留边界这一意思 → 范围

words.root_logic: rect（regere 导正、治理）+ -men（办法、结果）→ 拉丁语 regimen（治理的那一套办法）→ 掌权的那套班子；也指为身体定下的那套规程
words.origin: 法语 régime ← 拉丁语 regimen（统御、掌舵），出自 regere（导正、治理）
words.native_definition: a system of government, or a fixed course of treatment or living
words.core_concept: a fixed way of steering things – 定下来的那套管法
words.core_image: 墙上贴一张表，几点起床几点吃药几点熄灯，全楼照它走
examples: The old regime collapsed within a month.
Her doctor put her on a strict regime.
semantic_expansions: 掌着国事的那一套人马 → 政权
抽掉「国」只留那套办法 → 制度
把这套办法用到身体上 → 养生法、疗程

words.root_logic: rect（regere 划直、划界）→ 拉丁语 regionem（划出边界的那一片）→ 地面上圈定的一片；也指身上大致的一块
words.origin: 古法语 region ← 拉丁语 regio（属格 regionis：方向、界内之地），出自 regere（划直、导正）
words.native_definition: an area of land, or a part of the body
words.core_concept: a stretch marked off by a line – 用线圈出来的一片
words.core_image: 天气图上用虚线把几个省框在一起，框里同色，框外换色
examples: This region is famous for its wine.
He felt a dull pain in the chest region.
semantic_expansions: 地面上圈出的一整片 → 地区、区域
同样的圈法用在身体上，界限不必精确 → 部位

words.root_logic: re-（回、逐条）+ gerere（携带、载）→ 拉丁语 regesta（一条条载回来记下的东西）→ 那本册子；作动词是把名字载进册子
words.origin: 古法语 registre ← 中世纪拉丁语 registrum/regesta ← 拉丁语 regerere（re-＋gerere：载回、记入）；与 regere（导正）是两个不同的拉丁词，勿混
words.native_definition: to enter a name in an official list, or the list itself
words.core_concept: carry it back onto the list – 把它载回册子上记下
words.core_image: 门口一本厚簿，来人签下姓名和时间，笔迹一行接一行往下排
examples: You must register before using the service.
Her name appears in the parish register.
semantic_expansions: 把名字载进官册这个动作 → 注册
同一动作偏重「记下」这一面 → 登记
载好的那本册子本身 → 名册

words.root_logic: rect（regere 统摄）→ 拉丁语 regnum（王权、王国）→ 古法语 reigne → 坐在发号令的那个位子上；那段坐着的光景
words.origin: 古法语 reigne ← 拉丁语 regnum（王权），出自 rex（王），与 regere（统摄）同一词干；与同音的 rein（缰绳，出自 tenere 握住）不同源
words.native_definition: to rule as king or queen, or the period of such rule
words.core_concept: sit in the seat that gives orders – 坐在发令的那个位子上
words.core_image: 一个人坐在高处，三十年里下面的人都等他先开口
examples: Queen Victoria reigned for over sixty years.
Silence reigned in the empty hall.
semantic_expansions: 坐在那个位子上发号令 → 统治
把「坐着」这段光景单独看 → 在位期
不是人而是一种气氛压住全场 → 盛行、笼罩

words.root_logic: rect（regere 统摄）→ 拉丁语 regalis（王的）→ 古法语 roial ＋ -ty（身份、待遇）→ 属于王的那份身份，及按份额抽给他的那笔钱
words.origin: 古法语 roialte ← roial（王的）← 拉丁语 regalis，出自 rex（王），与 regere 同一词干
words.native_definition: members of a royal family, or a payment made to an owner for each use
words.core_concept: what belongs to the king – 归于王的那一份
words.core_image: 一家人进门从不排队；另外每卖出一本书，账上先划出一小笔送到他们那儿
examples: The hotel once housed European royalty.
She earns royalties from every copy sold.
semantic_expansions: 王这一支的人 → 王室
王这个身份自带的权柄 → 王权
王按份额抽走的那笔钱，后归于著作与专利的所有者 → 版税

words.root_logic: lig（ligare 绑）+ -able（能…的）→ 被绑在某事上、脱不开的；也指老被那事缠上
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 liable ← 古法语 lier（捆、系）← 拉丁语 ligare（绑）
words.native_definition: legally responsible for something, or likely to do or suffer something
words.core_concept: tied to what follows – 被后果系住脱不开
words.core_image: 合同末尾那行小字把签名的人和后面所有账目系在一处，抽不出手
examples: The company is liable for any damage caused.
Old pipes are liable to burst in winter.
semantic_expansions: 被条款绑在某事上 → 负有法律责任的
绑住的不是责任而是倾向，那事总来缠你 → 易于…的

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向、对着）+ lig（ligare 绑）→ 把人朝某事绑住；松一次绳算给人情面
words.origin: 古法语 obligier ← 拉丁语 obligare（ob-＋ligare：绑向），本指以誓约把人系住
words.native_definition: to make someone do something, or to do someone a favour
words.core_concept: bind someone toward a duty – 把人朝一件事上绑住
words.core_image: 一句允诺出口，绳子就套上了，后面推不掉也躲不开
examples: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
He obliged us by carrying the boxes upstairs.
semantic_expansions: 绑上就脱不开 → 迫使、责成
替人松一次绑，对方欠着这份情 → 使感激
从「欠情」回看施与的一方 → 帮忙、效劳

words.root_logic: re-（重新）+ al-（ad- 朝）+ li（ligare 绑）→ 法语 rallier（把散开的重新绑回一处）→ 重新聚拢；聚拢起来的那一场
words.origin: 法语 rallier ← 古法语 ralier（re-＋alier：结盟）← 拉丁语 alligare（ad-＋ligare：绑到一处）
words.native_definition: to come together again for a common purpose, or a mass meeting
words.core_concept: tie the scattered back together – 把散开的重新系回一处
words.core_image: 队伍被打散后，一声号响，四散的人又往同一面旗底下拢过来
examples: The captain rallied his men before the second half.
Thousands attended the rally in the square.
semantic_expansions: 散了的人重新系回一处 → 集合、召集
系回来之后力气也跟着回来 → 重整、恢复
系在一处的那一场 → 群众集会

words.root_logic: re-（牢牢、反复）+ li（ligare 绑）+ -able（可…的）→ 可以把自己系上去而不会脱的
words.origin: rely（依靠）＋-able；rely ← 古法语 relier ← 拉丁语 religare（re-＋ligare：牢牢绑住）
words.native_definition: able to be trusted to do what is expected
words.core_concept: safe to tie yourself to – 系上去不会脱的
words.core_image: 一根旧绳，每次吊上一整袋水泥都没松过，第二十次仍照样绷住
examples: We need a reliable car for long trips.
His account of the events seems reliable.
semantic_expansions: 绳子够牢，系上去不脱 → 可靠的
用在人身上，话和事都接得住 → 靠得住的

words.root_logic: rely（把自己系上去）+ -ance（这件事）→ 系上去这件事本身
words.origin: rely（依靠）＋-ance；rely ← 古法语 relier ← 拉丁语 religare（牢牢绑住）
words.native_definition: the state of depending on someone or something
words.core_concept: being tied to one support – 整个人系在一处依托上
words.core_image: 全村的水都从那一根管子来，管子一堵，家家都停
examples: The country's reliance on imported oil is growing.
She placed too much reliance on one supplier.
semantic_expansions: 把自己系在某物上不另找 → 依赖
系上去是因为信得过 → 信赖

words.root_logic: re-（牢牢）+ ly（ligare 绑）→ 拉丁语 religare（牢牢系住）→ 把自己系到某人某物上
words.origin: 古法语 relier（重新系紧、集结）← 拉丁语 religare（re-＋ligare：牢牢绑住）
words.native_definition: to depend on someone or something with confidence
words.core_concept: tie yourself to it and hand over the weight – 系上去，再把重量交给它
words.core_image: 过独木桥时一手死死攥住那根横绳，脚下每一步都压在它上面
examples: You can rely on her to finish on time.
Farmers here rely on the summer rain.
semantic_expansions: 把重量交到某物上 → 依靠
交得出去是因为信得过 → 信赖

words.root_logic: an-（无）+ onym（希腊语 onoma 名，与拉丁语 nomen 同一词干）+ -ous → 没有名字挂上去的
words.origin: 希腊语 anonymos（an-＋onyma：无名）经晚期拉丁语 anonymus 入英语；onoma 与拉丁语 nomen（名）同出一个更古的词干
words.native_definition: with a name that is not given or known
words.core_concept: no name attached – 名字这一栏空着
words.core_image: 桌上一封信，只写着收信地址，末尾该签字的地方空着，笔迹也认不出
examples: The donor wished to remain anonymous.
We received an anonymous tip by phone.
semantic_expansions: 名字这一栏留空 → 匿名的
从来就没被叫过名字 → 无名的
名字存在但外人不掌握 → 不知姓名的

words.root_logic: nomin（nomen 名）+ -al（…的）→ 只在名字上如此、里头不作数；小到只够挂个名
words.origin: 拉丁语 nominalis（属于名字的），出自 nomen（名）
words.native_definition: existing in name only, or very small in amount
words.core_concept: only the name is there – 只剩名字挂着
words.core_image: 招牌上还挂着他的姓，店里的事三年没经过他手，工资表上一年一元
examples: He is the nominal head of the company.
They charge a nominal fee for delivery.
semantic_expansions: 名字挂着而实权不在 → 名义上的
数目小到只够意思一下 → 象征性的
把「意思一下」再往下压 → 极小的

words.root_logic: nomin（nomen 名）+ -ate（做…）→ 拉丁语 nominare（叫出名字）→ 把某人的名字报上去
words.origin: 拉丁语 nominare（叫出名字、指名）的过去分词 nominatus，出自 nomen（名）
words.native_definition: to formally suggest someone for a position or prize
words.core_concept: call out a name for a post – 为一个位子报出名字
words.core_image: 会上有人站起来报出一个名字，书记员当场写在黑板最上一行
examples: She was nominated for best actress.
The board nominated him as treasurer.
semantic_expansions: 报出名字候选 → 提名
报出并当场定下 → 任命
不必是人，定某物某日也用 → 指定

words.root_logic: nomen（名）→ 古法语 nom/noun → 语法里专管「叫什么」的那一类词
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 noun ← 古法语 nom ← 拉丁语 nomen（名字、名称）
words.native_definition: a word that names a person, place, or thing
words.core_concept: the naming kind of word – 专管叫名字的那类词
words.core_image: 课本上一列词，每个都能指着一样东西说「这就是它」，前头添不了「很」
examples: In this sentence, water is a noun.
Children learn nouns before adjectives.

words.root_logic: pro-（代替）+ noun（nomen 名）→ 站在名字的位置上替它的那个词
words.origin: 拉丁语 pronomen（pro-（代）＋nomen（名））经中古法语 pronom 入英语
words.native_definition: a word used in place of a noun
words.core_concept: a stand-in for a name – 替名字站位的那个词
words.core_image: 前一句提过那个人名，后一句就用一个短词把那个位置占住，不再重复
examples: He and it are pronouns.
Try replacing the name with a pronoun.

words.root_logic: dec（decem 十）+ -ade（一批）→ 希腊语 dekas（一批十个）→ 十个年头凑成的那一段
words.origin: 古法语 decade ← 晚期拉丁语 decas（属格 decadis）← 希腊语 dekas（一批十个），与拉丁语 decem（十）同出一个更古的词干
words.native_definition: a period of ten years
words.core_concept: a batch of ten years – 十个年头凑成的一批
words.core_image: 墙上挂历换了十本，最旧那本纸都黄了，摞起来正好一叠
examples: Prices have doubled in the past decade.
He spent a decade abroad.

words.root_logic: decim（decimus 第十，出自 decem 十）+ -al → 以十为一档往上进；点后按十分之一逐级切下去的那种数
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 decimalis（属于十分之一的）← 拉丁语 decimus（第十），出自 decem（十）
words.native_definition: based on the number ten, or a fraction written after a point
words.core_concept: counting by tens – 满十进一
words.core_image: 尺子上每大格再切十小格，每小格又能想成再切十份，往右一直细下去
examples: Most countries use the decimal system.
Round the answer to two decimal places.
semantic_expansions: 满十进一这套算法 → 十进的
按十分之一逐级往下切出来的那种数 → 小数

words.root_logic: 拉丁语 duodecim（duo 二＋decem 十）→ 古法语 dozeine → 十再添二，凑成一整批
words.origin: 古法语 dozeine ← douze（十二）← 拉丁语 duodecim（duo（二）＋decem（十））
words.native_definition: a group of twelve
words.core_concept: ten and two in one batch – 十再添二，成一整批
words.core_image: 纸盒里三行四列摆满鸡蛋，盖子一合刚好，买的时候整盒论
examples: She bought a dozen eggs at the market.
Dozens of people waited outside.
semantic_expansions: 十二这个数目 → 十二个
按这个数目论装论卖 → 一打；复数泛指很多

words.root_logic: du-（duo 二）+ plic（折）+ -ate → 拉丁语 duplicare（折成两层）→ 对折一次，两半一模一样
words.origin: 拉丁语 duplicatus（duplicare 的过去分词：加倍、折成两份），由 duo（二）＋plicare（折叠）合成
words.native_definition: to make an exact copy, or one of two identical things
words.core_concept: folded into two alike halves – 对折成一样的两片
words.core_image: 一张纸正中对折，展开后两半的字迹一样，摞起来边线全对齐
examples: Please do not duplicate this file.
Keep a duplicate of the contract.
semantic_expansions: 对折出第二份这个动作 → 复制
折出来的那第二份 → 副本
两半分不出差别 → 完全相同的

words.root_logic: linea（亚麻绳绷紧后留下的一道痕）→ 那道痕本身；沿着它排开的人和字也叫它
words.origin: 古英语 line（绳、索）与古法语 ligne 合流 ← 拉丁语 linea（亚麻细绳、拉直的绳），出自 linum（亚麻）
words.native_definition: a long thin mark, or a row of people or things
words.core_concept: a taut cord's straight mark – 绷紧的绳留下的那一道
words.core_image: 粉笔贴着尺子在地上拖过去，留下笔直的一道白痕，孩子们脚尖顶着它站成一串
examples: Draw a straight line across the page.
A long line formed outside the shop.
semantic_expansions: 绳绷直弹出的那道痕 → 线、线条
沿着那道痕排开的人 → 队列，作动词是排成一列
排开的是字 → 一行

words.root_logic: linea（绷紧的绳留下的一道痕）+ -ar（…的）→ 只沿一道痕往前，不分叉不回头
words.origin: 拉丁语 linearis（属于线的），出自 linea（亚麻细绳、线），本源 linum（亚麻）
words.native_definition: arranged in or following a straight line or single sequence
words.core_concept: along one single thread – 只沿一根往前走
words.core_image: 故事从头讲到尾，中间不拐弯也不插叙，像一根绳从这头拉到那头
examples: The film has a simple linear plot.
Growth was roughly linear over ten years.
semantic_expansions: 顺一根往前不分叉 → 线性的
落到几何上就是不弯 → 直线的

words.root_logic: lin（linum 亚麻）+ -en（由…做成的）→ 亚麻纤维织出来的那种布，及用它做的家什
words.origin: 古英语 linen（用亚麻做的），出自古英语 lin（亚麻）——多认为是早期借自拉丁语 linum（亚麻）
words.native_definition: cloth woven from flax, or household articles made of it
words.core_concept: cloth made of flax – 亚麻织成的布
words.core_image: 浅黄的一块布，手一摸发凉发脆，迎光能看见经纬交错的方格
examples: The tablecloth is made of linen.
Fresh linen was put on every bed.
semantic_expansions: 亚麻纤维织成的那种布 → 亚麻布
拿它做的床单桌布一类 → 家用织品

words.root_logic: line（航线，出自 linea 拉直的绳）+ -er（干这个的）→ 固定沿一条路来回跑的那一艘；也指沿内壁铺的那一层
words.origin: line（线、航线）＋-er；line ← 拉丁语 linea（亚麻细绳、线），出自 linum（亚麻）
words.native_definition: a large ship or aircraft on a regular route, or a lining put inside something
words.core_concept: the one that runs a fixed line – 固定跑一条路的那一个
words.core_image: 码头边泊着一条特别长的白船，每月同一天靠岸，舷梯一放人往下走
examples: They crossed the Atlantic on an ocean liner.
Put a fresh liner in the bin.
semantic_expansions: 沿固定一条路来回跑的船 → 班轮
同样跑固定航路的飞机 → 大型客机
贴着内壁铺的那一层 → 内衬

words.root_logic: banca（钱桌）+ rupt（rumpere 打断）→ 钱桌被砸断，账再也摆不上去 → 还不出钱的
words.origin: 意大利语 banca rotta（被砸断的钱桌）；rotta ← 拉丁语 rupta，出自 rumpere（打断、使断裂）
words.native_definition: unable to pay what is owed, or a person in that state
words.core_concept: the money table smashed – 收钱的桌子被砸断
words.core_image: 市场上那张收钱的木桌被劈成两截，摊主再没人敢把银子放上去
examples: The company went bankrupt last spring.
He was declared a bankrupt in court.
semantic_expansions: 钱桌断了付不出钱 → 破产的
落到人身上 → 破产者
连别的东西也一样空 → 极度缺乏的

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出来）+ rupt（rumpere 断裂）→ 封住的地方裂开，里头的东西猛地冲出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 eruptus，erumpere（ex-＋rumpere：破而出）的过去分词
words.native_definition: to burst out suddenly and violently
words.core_concept: break open and burst out – 裂开一道口冲出来
words.core_image: 山顶那层硬壳裂开一道口，火光顺着口子直冲上去，山脚的窗玻璃跟着响
examples: The volcano erupted without warning.
Violence erupted after the match.
semantic_expansions: 封住的地方裂开冲出 → 爆发、喷发
不是岩浆而是情绪或冲突 → 突然发作

words.root_logic: rupta（被打断、硬破开的）→ 通俗拉丁语 rupta via（硬开出来的那条道）→ 一条固定走的路
words.origin: 古法语 rute ← 通俗拉丁语 rupta（破开的路），出自拉丁语 rumpere（打断、破开）
words.native_definition: a way taken from one place to another
words.core_concept: a way broken through – 硬破开出来的那条道
words.core_image: 林子里被人踩出一条通道，两边枝条齐齐断在同一个高度
examples: We took the coastal route home.
The bus follows a fixed route.
semantic_expansions: 破开障碍走通的那条道 → 路线、路径
同样固定走的水上或空中一条 → 航线

words.root_logic: route（破开出来的固定一条道）+ -ine → 天天走同一条道，走成了定式
words.origin: 法语 routine（走惯的路数）← route（路线）← 通俗拉丁语 rupta，出自拉丁语 rumpere（打断、破开）
words.native_definition: a fixed and regular way of doing things
words.core_concept: the path worn by walking it daily – 天天走出来的那条定式
words.core_image: 每天七点出门走同一条道，第三百次已经不用看路，脚自己知道在哪拐
examples: Brushing your teeth is part of the morning routine.
This is a routine inspection.
semantic_expansions: 同一条道走成定式 → 例行程序、惯例
作形容词是按定式来的 → 日常的、常规的

words.root_logic: en-（进入）+ joy（gaudium 心里高兴）→ 进到那股高兴里去；也指把某物的好处握在手里
words.origin: 古法语 enjoier（使高兴、享有）← en-（入）＋joie（喜悦）← 拉丁语 gaudia，出自 gaudium（喜悦）
words.native_definition: to take pleasure in something, or to have the benefit of it
words.core_concept: step into the gladness – 进到那股高兴里去
words.core_image: 一碗汤喝到最后一口，还用勺把碗底刮了刮
examples: We enjoyed the concert very much.
Citizens enjoy equal rights under the law.
semantic_expansions: 泡在那股高兴里 → 享受
长期泡着就成了偏好 → 喜爱
把「握着好处」这一面单拿出来 → 享有

words.root_logic: gaudium（心里高兴）的复数 gaudia → 古法语 joie → 那股劲儿涌上来；也指引起它的那件事
words.origin: 古法语 joie ← 拉丁语 gaudia（gaudium 的复数：喜悦）
words.native_definition: great gladness, or a thing that causes it
words.core_concept: gladness welling over – 那股高兴涌上来漫出去
words.core_image: 门一开看见人回来了，手里提的东西掉在地上也顾不上捡
examples: Her face was full of joy.
Gardening is one of his great joys.
semantic_expansions: 涌上来的那股劲儿 → 欢乐、喜悦
引起它的那件事或那个人 → 乐事

words.root_logic: re-（加强）+ joice（gaudium 心里高兴）→ 那股劲儿一直冒到外面，别人也看得见
words.origin: 古法语 rejoir/resjoir（大为高兴）← re-＋joir（高兴）← 拉丁语 gaudere（心里高兴），名词 gaudium
words.native_definition: to feel and show great gladness
words.core_concept: let the gladness show outside – 让那股劲儿冒到外面来
words.core_image: 全镇的人涌到街上，锅碗瓢盆都敲起来，谁碰见谁都要抱一下
examples: The whole village rejoiced at the news.
We rejoiced that no one had been hurt.
semantic_expansions: 冒到外面被人看见 → 欢欣、额手称庆
因为躲过一劫才冒出来 → 庆幸

words.root_logic: nav（navis 船）+ -al（…的）→ 属于战船的，及操这些船的那支军
words.origin: 拉丁语 navalis（船的），出自 navis（船）
words.native_definition: of or relating to a navy or warships
words.core_concept: belonging to the ships of war – 属于战船那一路
words.core_image: 港里一排灰色钢壳船靠着码头，桅上旗子一齐朝同一个方向，甲板上的人列队站着
examples: He served at a naval base for six years.
The naval battle lasted two days.
semantic_expansions: 属于战船本身 → 军舰的
属于操这些船的那支军 → 海军的

words.root_logic: nav（navis 船）+ ig（agere 驱动）+ -ation → 拉丁语 navigare（驱船前行）→ 一边把船开出去一边找准方向
words.origin: 拉丁语 navigatio ← navigare，由 navis（船）＋agere（驱动）合成
words.native_definition: the act of steering a ship or aircraft and finding the way
words.core_concept: drive the ship and find the way – 把船开出去并找准方向
words.core_image: 夜里舵手对着星子和罗盘来回比对，才把船头拨正半格
examples: Navigation is difficult in thick fog.
The plane's navigation system failed.
semantic_expansions: 把船开出去这件事 → 航行
开的时候要找准方向 → 导航
这一整套本事 → 航海术

words.root_logic: navis（船）→ 古法语 navie（一国的船队）→ 一国的战船连人算作一支；这支人身上那种蓝也随之得名
words.origin: 古法语 navie（船队）← 晚期拉丁语 navigia（navigium 的复数：船只），出自 navis（船）
words.native_definition: a country's warships and the people who operate them
words.core_concept: a nation's ships as one force – 一国的船连人算作一支
words.core_image: 一队军舰列成纵队出港，水兵制服是那种近乎发黑的蓝
examples: He joined the navy at eighteen.
She wore a navy coat.
semantic_expansions: 一国的战船连操船的人 → 海军、舰队
这支人制服上那种深蓝 → 藏青色

words.root_logic: plat（与 platea 同出希腊语 platys：宽而平的一片）+ -e → 扁平的一片，用来盛放；也指蒙在表面的那一层薄金属
words.origin: 古法语 plate（扁平的一片）← 中世纪拉丁语 plata（金属薄片），或经通俗拉丁语 *plattus，其构形照希腊语 platys（宽而平的）而来；两者同溯 PIE *plat-（摊开）
words.native_definition: a flat dish, a thin sheet of metal, or to cover with a thin layer of metal
words.core_concept: a broad flat piece – 宽而平的一片
words.core_image: 扁而平的一片瓷，边上抬起一圈浅沿，饭菜都摊在中间那块平面上
examples: She put the fish on a white plate.
The handle is plated with silver.
semantic_expansions: 扁平一片用来盛饭菜 → 盘子
同样扁平但是金属 → 金属板
把这层薄金属蒙到别的东西上 → 电镀

words.root_logic: plat（与 platea 同出希腊语 platys：宽而平的一片）+ -eau（小、块）→ 高处那一大块平地；引申为曲线走平的那一段
words.origin: 法语 plateau ← 古法语 platel（扁平的小盘）← plat（平的）← 通俗拉丁语 *plattus，照希腊语 platys（宽而平的）构形，同溯 PIE *plat-（摊开）
words.native_definition: a large area of high level ground, or a period of no change
words.core_concept: flat ground up high – 高处摊平的一大块
words.core_image: 车爬了一整天，上到顶却是一大片平地，风从四面横着刮过来
examples: The plateau lies three thousand metres above sea level.
Sales have reached a plateau.
semantic_expansions: 高处那一大块平地 → 高原
曲线爬到某处不再往上 → 停滞期

words.root_logic: plat（与 platea 同出希腊语 platys：宽而平的一片）+ form（形状）→ 一块摊平抬高的面；站上去说话，那套主张也叫它
words.origin: 法语 plateforme（plat 平的＋forme 形状）；plat ← 通俗拉丁语 *plattus，照希腊语 platys（宽而平的）构形，forme ← 拉丁语 forma（形状）
words.native_definition: a raised level surface, or the stated aims of a group
words.core_concept: a flat raised surface to stand on – 摊平抬高、供人站的那块面
words.core_image: 比地面高出一截的一条长台，边上一道黄线，人都站在线后头等
examples: The train leaves from platform four.
Housing was central to their platform.
semantic_expansions: 抬高摊平供人站候 → 站台
泛指凡摊平抬高的面 → 平台
站上去讲的那套主张 → 纲领

words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 alterare（使成为另一个）← 拉丁语 alter（两者中的另一个）
words.native_definition: to change something, or to become different
words.core_concept: make it into the other one – 把它弄成另一个样
words.core_image: 裁缝把腰身往里收两指，别处一针没动，穿上身却是另一个样子
examples: We had to alter our plans.
The tailor altered the sleeves for me.
semantic_expansions: 整体变成另一个样 → 改变
只动其中一处 → 改动
专指改衣服的尺寸 → 改衣服
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 法语 alternatif ← 中世纪拉丁语 alternativus ← 拉丁语 alternare（轮着来），出自 alter（两者中的另一个）
words.native_definition: another possibility that can be chosen instead
words.core_concept: the other one you could take instead – 你本可以走的那另一条
words.core_image: 路口分出两条道，走上这条，那条的尽头这辈子就到不了
examples: Is there an alternative to surgery?
They offer an alternative route.
semantic_expansions: 可以换着走的那一条 → 替代方案
作形容词即可换的 → 可选的
不走众人那条 → 另类的
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: dialis（一日的，出自 diurnus）→ 把一天的时辰刻成一圈的那个面 → 凡刻着数字的圆面；作动词是照着圆面上的数字转
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 dialis（一日的），出自拉丁语 dies（日）与 diurnus（一日的）；本指日影盘
words.native_definition: a round face marked with numbers, or to make a telephone call
words.core_concept: a round face where the hours are marked – 把时辰刻成一圈的那个面
words.core_image: 圆面上排一圈数字，手指插进孔里转到底再松开，它自己咔咔转回来
examples: The dial on the old radio still works.
She dialled the number twice.
semantic_expansions: 日影一圈刻出时辰 → 表盘
凡刻着数字的圆面 → 刻度盘
照着圆面上的数字转 → 拨号

words.root_logic: diurnus（一日的）→ 拉丁语 diarium（每日的一份、每日所记）→ 按日一条条记下的那本
words.origin: 拉丁语 diarium（每日的份额、日志），出自 dies（日）与 diurnus（一日的）
words.native_definition: a book in which you record events day by day
words.core_concept: one day, one entry – 一天记一条
words.core_image: 台灯下摊开一本，先写上日期，底下三两行今天发生的事
examples: He kept a diary for thirty years.
Let me check my diary for next week.
semantic_expansions: 按日记下的那些条目 → 日记
装这些条目的那本 → 日记本
同一本用来记以后的日子 → 记事本

words.origin: 古法语 monter（往上走）← 通俗拉丁语 *montare ← 拉丁语 mons（属格 montis：山）
words.native_definition: to go up onto something, to increase, or to fix in place
words.core_concept: go up onto it – 往上登到它上面去
words.core_image: 一脚踩住马镫，手一撑翻上去坐稳，脚底下的高度一下就起来了
examples: He mounted the horse and rode off.
Pressure on the government is mounting.
semantic_expansions: 往上登到某物上 → 登上、骑上
不是人往上而是数目往上 → 增加
把东西架上去固定住 → 安装
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 montaigne ← 通俗拉丁语 *montanea ← 拉丁语 montanus（山地的），出自 mons（属格 montis：山）
words.native_definition: a very high natural elevation of the earth's surface
words.core_concept: ground heaped up out of reach – 堆起来高到摸不着顶的那块地
words.core_image: 抬头看不到顶，云在半腰横着挂住，人走一天还在脚下那一段
examples: They climbed the mountain in two days.
A mountain of paperwork waited for him.
semantic_expansions: 地面隆起特别高的一块 → 山
连成一串的那些 → 山脉
拿它的体量比喻堆起来的东西 → 大量
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: main（manu，← manus 手）+ tain（tenere 握住）→ 手里一直托着不让它塌；话也一样，攥住不松口
words.origin: 古法语 maintenir ← 中世纪拉丁语 manutenere（manu（← manus 手）＋tenere（握住）：手里托住）
words.native_definition: to keep something in good condition, or to insist that something is true
words.core_concept: hold it up by hand – 用手一直把它托住
words.core_image: 屋顶塌了一角，几根柱子从下面撑住不让它继续往下掉，每年还得上一遍油
examples: The government must maintain public order.
He maintains that he never saw her.
semantic_expansions: 一直托住不让它垮 → 维持
托住之外还得修理 → 保养
攥住自己那句话不松 → 坚称

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ in（tenere 握住）→ 拉丁语 retinere（往回拉住）→ 手里那两条往回一收就能让马停下的皮带
words.origin: 古法语 reine ← 通俗拉丁语 *retina ← 拉丁语 retinere（re-＋tenere：往回拉住）；与同音的 reign（王权，出自 regnum）不同源
words.native_definition: a strap used to control a horse, or to hold something back
words.core_concept: the strap you pull back on – 往回一拉就能收住的那条带子
words.core_image: 手里两条皮带往后一收，马蹄立刻慢下来，头也跟着侧过来
examples: She pulled on the reins to stop the horse.
The bank reined in its lending.
semantic_expansions: 往回拉住马的那条带子 → 缰绳
手里握着这条带子就说得上话 → 控制
不让它跑出界 → 约束

words.root_logic: planus（平的、无起伏）→ 意大利语 piano（平缓、柔和）→ pianoforte（柔—强，指这件乐器轻按轻响重砸重响）→ 截短成 piano
words.origin: 意大利语 piano（柔和）← 拉丁语 planus（平的、无起伏）；全名 pianoforte（柔—强），后截短
words.native_definition: a large keyboard instrument with strings struck by hammers

examples: She has played the piano since she was six.
A piano stood in the corner of the hall.

words.native_definition: pleasant, agreeable, or kind

examples: We had a nice time at the beach.
It was nice of you to call.
